Dynamics of Asset Demands with Confidence Heterogeneity

To understand the dynamics of investors’ asset demands, we develop a general-equilibrium model driven by a single latent variable: heterogeneity in investors’ confidence about mean endowment growth. The model predicts persistent heterogeneity in asset demands and concentrated portfolios. Consistent with the data, limited confidence reduces investors’ demand elasticities and makes stock prices excessively volatile—driven by latent demand rather than observable characteristics. The underlying economic mechanisms are driven primarily by investors’ desire to hedge changes in future beliefs instead of current disagreement. Finally, consistent with survey data, investors’ expectations correlate positively with past returns and negatively with future returns.

before.title_zh: 信心异质性下资产需求的动态变化
before.abstract_zh: 为理解投资者资产需求的动态变化，我们构建了一个由单一潜在变量驱动的广义均衡模型：投资者对平均禀赋增长信心的异质性。该模型预测资产需求存在持续异质性以及组合集中化。与数据一致，有限的信心降低了投资者的需求弹性，并使股票价格过度波动——这由潜在需求而非可观测特征所驱动。其背后的经济机制主要由投资者对冲未来信念变化而非当前分歧的意愿所驱动。最后，与调查数据一致，投资者的预期与过去收益正相关，与未来收益负相关。

after.title_zh: 信心异质性下资产需求的动态变化
after.abstract_zh: 为理解投资者资产需求的动态变化，我们构建了一个由单一潜在变量驱动的广义均衡模型：投资者对平均禀赋增长信心的异质性。该模型预测资产需求存在持续异质性以及组合集中化。与数据一致，有限的信心降低了投资者的需求弹性，并使股票价格过度波动——这由潜在需求而非可观测特征所驱动。其背后的经济机制主要由投资者对冲未来信念变化而非当前分歧的意愿所驱动。最后，与调查数据一致，投资者的预期与过去收益正相关，与未来收益负相关。

entries.title: Partial Equilibrium Thinking, Extrapolation, and Bubbles

source_records.title: Partial Equilibrium Thinking, Extrapolation, and Bubbles
source_records.abstract: We develop a dynamic theory of “Partial Equilibrium Thinking” (PET), which micro-founds time-varying return extrapolation: extrapolative beliefs are present at all times, but only sometimes manifest themselves in explosive ways. We formalize the distinction between normal times shocks and “displacement shocks,” and study their interaction with extrapolative beliefs. In normal times, PET generates constant extrapolation and momentum. After a displacement shock that increases uncertainty, PET leads to stronger and time-varying extrapolation, triggering bubbles and endogenous crashes. Our theory sheds light on both market dynamics in normal times and Kindleberger’s narrative of bubbles within a unified framework.

After a displacement shock that increases uncertainty, PET leads to stronger and time-varying extrapolation, triggering bubbles and endogenous crashes. Our theory sheds light on both market dynamics in normal times and Kindleberger’s narrative of bubbles within a unified framework.

entries.title: What Hundreds of Economic News Events Say About Belief Overreaction in the Stock Market

source_records.title: What Hundreds of Economic News Events Say About Belief Overreaction in the Stock Market
source_records.abstract: We measure the nature and severity of a variety of belief distortions in market reactions to hundreds of economic news events by synthesizing structural estimation with algorithmic machine learning to quantify bias. We find that investors systematically overreact to perceptions about multiple fundamental shocks, a phenomenon we show often dampens rather than amplifies market volatility via a “shock composition effect.” Such effects imply that the stock market can underreact to news, even when investors overreact to all shocks.

source_records.title: Beliefs and Portfolios: Causal Evidence
source_records.abstract: We causally test alternative theories of expectation formation. Using a randomized information experiment we show overreaction is a key feature of individuals’ return expectations, and individuals’ response to the price-earnings ratio is opposite of academic consensus. Our evidence is inconsistent with standard models of expectation formation, but subjective mental models that deviate from objective benchmarks can jointly explain the updating behavior in the experiment, the link between individuals’ prior perceptions and expectations, and the heterogeneity of updating. Conditional on their beliefs, individuals’ sensitivity of equity shares in a hypothetical portfolio choice experiment is consistent with the standard Merton model.

Using a randomized information experiment we show overreaction is a key feature of individuals’ return expectations, and individuals’ response to the price-earnings ratio is opposite of academic consensus. Our evidence is inconsistent with standard models of expectation formation, but subjective mental models that deviate from objective benchmarks can jointly explain the updating behavior in the experiment, the link between individuals’ prior perceptions and expectations, and the heterogeneity of updating. Conditional on their beliefs, individuals’ sensitivity of equity shares in a hypothetical portfolio choice experiment is consistent with the standard Merton model.

before.title_zh: 信念与投资组合：因果证据
before.abstract_zh: 我们因果性地检验了关于预期形成的替代理论。通过一项随机信息实验，我们表明反应过度是个体回报预期的一个关键特征，而个体对市盈率的反应与学术共识相反。我们的证据与标准的预期形成模型不一致，但偏离客观基准的主观心智模型能够共同解释实验中的更新行为、个体先前感知与预期之间的联系以及更新的异质性。在其信念给定的条件下，个体在假设性投资组合选择实验中股票份额的敏感性与标准的默顿模型一致。

blocks.text: Beliefs and Portfolios: Causal Evidence
Beliefs and Portfolios: Causal Evidence
Beliefs and Portfolios: Causal Evidence

We causally test alternative theories of expectation formation. Using a randomized information experiment we show overreaction is a key feature of individuals’ return expectations, and individuals’ response to the price-earnings ratio is opposite of academic consensus. Our evidence is inconsistent with standard models of expectation formation, but subjective mental models that deviate from objective benchmarks can jointly explain the updating behavior in the experiment, the link between individuals’ prior perceptions and expectations, and the heterogeneity of updating. Conditional on their beliefs, individuals’ sensitivity of equity shares in a hypothetical portfolio choice experiment is consistent with the standard Merton model.

after.title_zh: 信念与投资组合：因果证据
after.abstract_zh: 我们因果性地检验了关于预期形成的替代理论。通过一项随机信息实验，我们表明反应过度是个体回报预期的一个关键特征，而个体对市盈率的反应与学术共识相反。我们的证据与标准的预期形成模型不一致，但偏离客观基准的主观心智模型能够共同解释实验中的更新行为、个体先前感知与预期之间的联系以及更新的异质性。在其信念给定的条件下，个体在假设性投资组合选择实验中股票份额的敏感性与标准的默顿模型一致。

source_records.title: What Drives Variation in Investor Portfolios? Estimating the Roles of Beliefs and Risk Preferences
source_records.abstract: We present a portfolio choice demand model that allows for the nonparametric estimation of investors’ (subjective) expectations and risk preferences. Using comprehensive 401(k)-plan-level data from 2009 through 2019, we explore heterogeneity in asset allocations using our empirical framework. We recover investors’ beliefs about each asset and examine the implications and potential sources of those beliefs. Heterogeneity in expectations across investors accounts for twice as much variation in portfolio holdings as heterogeneity in risk aversion. Belief heterogeneity is partly driven by investors’ characteristics and experiences, reflecting local sources of information such as county-level GDP and employers’ past performance.

What Drives Variation in Investor Portfolios? Estimating the Roles of Beliefs and Risk Preferences
What Drives Variation in Investor Portfolios? Estimating the Roles of Beliefs and Risk Preferences

We present a portfolio choice demand model that allows for the nonparametric estimation of investors’ (subjective) expectations and risk preferences. Using comprehensive 401(k)-plan-level data from 2009 through 2019, we explore heterogeneity in asset allocations using our empirical framework. We recover investors’ beliefs about each asset and examine the implications and potential sources of those beliefs. Heterogeneity in expectations across investors accounts for twice as much variation in portfolio holdings as heterogeneity in risk aversion. Belief heterogeneity is partly driven by investors’ characteristics and experiences, reflecting local sources of information such as county-level GDP and employers’ past performance.

before.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个投资组合选择需求模型，该模型允许对投资者的（主观）预期和风险偏好进行非参数估计。利用从2009年到2019年的全面401(k)-计划层面数据，我们使用我们的实证框架探讨了资产配置中的异质性。我们还原了投资者对每种资产的信念，并考察了这些信念的含义和潜在来源。投资者之间预期的异质性对投资组合持有变异的解释力是风险厌恶异质性的两倍。信念异质性部分由投资者的特征和经历驱动，反映了地方信息来源，如县级GDP和雇主的过往表现。

blocks.text: What Drives Variation in Investor Portfolios? Estimating the Roles of Beliefs and Risk Preferences
What Drives Variation in Investor Portfolios? Estimating the Roles of Beliefs and Risk Preferences
What Drives Variation in Investor Portfolios? Estimating the Roles of Beliefs and Risk Preferences

We present a portfolio choice demand model that allows for the nonparametric estimation of investors’ (subjective) expectations and risk preferences. Using comprehensive 401(k)-plan-level data from 2009 through 2019, we explore heterogeneity in asset allocations using our empirical framework. We recover investors’ beliefs about each asset and examine the implications and potential sources of those beliefs. Heterogeneity in expectations across investors accounts for twice as much variation in portfolio holdings as heterogeneity in risk aversion. Belief heterogeneity is partly driven by investors’ characteristics and experiences, reflecting local sources of information such as county-level GDP and employers’ past performance.

entries.title: Who Clears the Market When Passive Investors Trade?

source_records.title: Who Clears the Market When Passive Investors Trade?
source_records.abstract: We find that firms are the primary sellers who clear the market for index fund buying, providing shares at a nearly one-for-one rate. Most demand-side institutions trade in the same direction as index funds rather than accommodating passive demand. We use two instruments for index fund demand and show that firms causally respond to exogenous passive demand, with prices serving as the coordinating mechanism. Firms satisfy passive demand mostly through nonprimary market issuance, for example, through employee stock-based compensation. Our results suggest that passive investing has systematically supplied capital to firms by enabling equity issuance over the last two decades.

before.title_zh: 当被动投资者交易时，谁在清算市场？
before.abstract_zh: 我们发现，公司是主要的卖方，它们以几乎一比一的比例提供股票，为指数基金的买入清算市场。大多数需求侧机构与指数基金同向交易，而不是迎合被动需求。我们为指数基金需求使用了两个工具变量，并表明公司对外生的被动需求做出因果反应，价格充当协调机制。公司主要通过非一级市场发行来满足被动需求，例如通过员工股票薪酬。我们的结果表明，在过去二十年中，被动投资通过使股票发行成为可能，系统性地向公司提供了资本。

after.title_zh: 当被动投资者交易时，谁在清算市场？
after.abstract_zh: 我们发现，公司是主要的卖方，它们以几乎一比一的比例提供股票，为指数基金的买入清算市场。大多数需求侧机构与指数基金同向交易，而不是迎合被动需求。我们为指数基金需求使用了两个工具变量，并表明公司对外生的被动需求做出因果反应，价格充当协调机制。公司主要通过非一级市场发行来满足被动需求，例如通过员工股票薪酬。我们的结果表明，在过去二十年中，被动投资通过使股票发行成为可能，系统性地向公司提供了资本。

existing_records.title: Who Clears the Market When Passive Investors Trade?

authors.name: Marco Sammon and John J Shim

existing_records.abstract: We find that firms are the primary sellers who clear the market for index fund buying, providing shares at a nearly one-for-one rate. Most demand-side institutions trade in the same direction as index funds rather than accommodating passive demand. We use two instruments for index fund demand and show that firms causally respond to exogenous passive demand, with prices serving as the coordinating mechanism. Firms satisfy passive demand mostly through nonprimary market issuance, for example, through employee stock-based compensation. Our results suggest that passive investing has systematically supplied capital to firms by enabling equity issuance over the last two decades.

What Drives Momentum and Reversal? Evidence from Day and Night Signals

We study how intraday and overnight components of past returns predict future stock returns from 1926 to 2019. Portfolios formed on past intraday returns display momentum without long-term reversal, whereas portfolios formed on past overnight returns display no momentum. We link this asymmetric day-night pattern to the fact that most trading occurs intraday, which has remained stable over time. Evidence from international stock markets, intraday intervals, and analyst expectations suggests that investors underreact to private information revealed through trading. This underreaction mechanism is most consistent with Hong and Stein’s (1999) theory of momentum.

before.title_zh: 什么驱动了动量与反转？来自日间与夜间信号的证据
before.abstract_zh: 我们研究了从1926年到2019年，过去收益的日内与隔夜成分如何预测未来股票收益。基于过去日内收益构建的投资组合表现出动量，且没有长期反转，而基于过去隔夜收益构建的投资组合则没有表现出动量。我们将这种日间与夜间的不对称模式与以下事实联系起来：大多数交易发生在日内，而这一事实随时间保持稳定。来自国际股票市场、日内区间和分析师预期的证据表明，投资者对通过交易揭示的私人信息反应不足。这种反应不足机制与Hong和Stein（1999）的动量理论最为一致。

existing_records.title: What Drives Momentum and Reversal? Evidence from Day and Night Signals
existing_records.abstract: We study how intraday and overnight components of past returns predict future stock returns from 1926 to 2019. Portfolios formed on past intraday returns display momentum without long-term reversal, whereas portfolios formed on past overnight returns display no momentum. We link this asymmetric day-night pattern to the fact that most trading occurs intraday, which has remained stable over time. Evidence from international stock markets, intraday intervals, and analyst expectations suggests that investors underreact to private information revealed through trading. This underreaction mechanism is most consistent with Hong and Stein’s (1999) theory of momentum.

after.title_zh: 什么驱动了动量与反转？来自日间与夜间信号的证据
after.abstract_zh: 我们研究了从1926年到2019年，过去收益的日内与隔夜成分如何预测未来股票收益。基于过去日内收益构建的投资组合表现出动量，且没有长期反转，而基于过去隔夜收益构建的投资组合则没有表现出动量。我们将这种日间与夜间的不对称模式与以下事实联系起来：大多数交易发生在日内，而这一事实随时间保持稳定。来自国际股票市场、日内区间和分析师预期的证据表明，投资者对通过交易揭示的私人信息反应不足。这种反应不足机制与Hong和Stein（1999）的动量理论最为一致。

source_records.title: The Need for Fees at a DEX: How Increases in Fees Can Increase DEX Trading Volume
source_records.abstract: We model endogenous trading and liquidity provision at a decentralized exchange (DEX) and demonstrate that increasing DEX trading fees can increase DEX trading volume. DEXs employ a mechanical pricing rule whereby price impacts decrease with inventory that DEXs acquire by offering fee revenues to investors. Consequently, higher DEX fees can incentivize higher inventory, thereby reducing price impacts. Moreover, the reduction of price impact can offset the increase in fees so that the marginal cost of DEX trading declines despite charging a higher trading fee. In turn, lower DEX marginal trading costs lead to an increase in DEX trading volume.

before.title_zh: DEX对费用的需求：费用增加如何能提高DEX交易量
before.abstract_zh: 我们对去中心化交易所（DEX）中的内生交易与流动性提供进行建模，并证明提高DEX交易费用可以增加DEX交易量。DEX采用一种机械定价规则，即价格影响随DEX通过向投资者提供费用收入而获得的库存增加而减小。因此，更高的DEX费用可以激励更高的库存，从而降低价格影响。此外，价格影响的降低可以抵消费用的增加，以至于尽管收取更高的交易费用，DEX交易的边际成本仍下降。进而，更低的DEX边际交易成本导致DEX交易量增加。

selected_fields.title: Do Mutual Funds Respond to Mechanical Changes in ESG Ratings?
selected_fields.authors: Seungju Choi, Fabrizio Ferri, Daniele Macciocchi

proofs.text: Do Mutual Funds Respond to Mechanical Changes in ESG Ratings?
Seungju Choi, Fabrizio Ferri, Daniele Macciocchi

source_records.title: Do Mutual Funds Respond to Mechanical Changes in ESG Ratings?
source_records.abstract: Using a quasi-experimental setting, we study whether mutual fund investors respond to a purely mechanical change in environmental, social, and governance (ESG) ratings—that is, a change independent of concurrent changes in firms’ actual ESG activities. We find that when a firm experiences a mechanical increase in ESG ratings, the probability of being selected by an ESG fund increases (extensive margin). In contrast, if the firm is already in the fund’s portfolio, its holdings do not change (intensive margin), consistent with portfolio weighting being based on market capitalization. The selection effect is observable not only among funds that follow an ESG index but also among active ESG funds, which presumably should have the resources and ability to identify and filter out the mechanical increase in ESG ratings. Among active ESG funds, the selection effect is stronger for funds with less assets under management, larger portfolios of firms, and lower expense ratios, consistent with the notion that resource constraints may impede a fund’s screening ability. Our findings imply that passive investing based on commercial ESG ratings—whether due to resource constraints or portfolio indexing—might result in portfolio allocations that do not reflect the actual ESG activities of firms.

before.title_zh: 共同基金会对ESG评级的机械性变化作出反应吗？
before.abstract_zh: 我们利用一个准实验情境，研究共同基金投资者是否会对环境、社会和治理（ESG）评级的纯粹机械性变化作出反应——即一种独立于企业实际ESG活动同期变化的评级变化。我们发现，当一家企业经历ESG评级的机械性上升时，其被ESG基金选中的概率上升（广延边际）。相反，如果该企业已在基金的投资组合中，其持仓不会变化（集约边际），这与投资组合权重基于市值相一致。这种选择效应不仅存在于跟踪ESG指数的基金中，也存在于主动型ESG基金中，而后者按理说应拥有资源和能力来识别并过滤掉ESG评级的机械性上升。在主动型ESG基金中，对于管理资产规模较小、企业投资组合较大以及费用比率较低的基金，选择效应更强，这与资源约束可能阻碍基金筛选能力的观点相一致。我们的发现意味着，基于商业ESG评级的被动投资——无论是由于资源约束还是投资组合指数化——都可能导致投资组合配置并不反映企业实际的ESG活动。

existing_records.title: Do Mutual Funds Respond to Mechanical Changes in ESG Ratings?
existing_records.abstract: Using a quasi-experimental setting, we study whether mutual fund investors respond to a purely mechanical change in environmental, social, and governance (ESG) ratings—that is, a change independent of concurrent changes in firms’ actual ESG activities. We find that when a firm experiences a mechanical increase in ESG ratings, the probability of being selected by an ESG fund increases (extensive margin). In contrast, if the firm is already in the fund’s portfolio, its holdings do not change (intensive margin), consistent with portfolio weighting being based on market capitalization. The selection effect is observable not only among funds that follow an ESG index but also among active ESG funds, which presumably should have the resources and ability to identify and filter out the mechanical increase in ESG ratings. Among active ESG funds, the selection effect is stronger for funds with less assets under management, larger portfolios of firms, and lower expense ratios, consistent with the notion that resource constraints may impede a fund’s screening ability. Our findings imply that passive investing based on commercial ESG ratings—whether due to resource constraints or portfolio indexing—might result in portfolio allocations that do not reflect the actual ESG activities of firms.

after.title_zh: 共同基金会对ESG评级的机械性变化作出反应吗？
after.abstract_zh: 我们利用一个准实验情境，研究共同基金投资者是否会对环境、社会和治理（ESG）评级的纯粹机械性变化作出反应——即一种独立于企业实际ESG活动同期变化的评级变化。我们发现，当一家企业经历ESG评级的机械性上升时，其被ESG基金选中的概率上升（广延边际）。相反，如果该企业已在基金的投资组合中，其持仓不会变化（集约边际），这与投资组合权重基于市值相一致。这种选择效应不仅存在于跟踪ESG指数的基金中，也存在于主动型ESG基金中，而后者按理说应拥有资源和能力来识别并过滤掉ESG评级的机械性上升。在主动型ESG基金中，对于管理资产规模较小、企业投资组合较大以及费用比率较低的基金，选择效应更强，这与资源约束可能阻碍基金筛选能力的观点相一致。我们的发现意味着，基于商业ESG评级的被动投资——无论是由于资源约束还是投资组合指数化——都可能导致投资组合配置并不反映企业实际的ESG活动。

source_records.title: Mis(sed) Diagnosis: Physician Decision-Making and ADHD
source_records.abstract: The mechanisms driving disparities in mental health care are not well understood. This paper develops a structural model of diagnosis for attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), highlighting how patient and physician factors can result in disparities. Using electronic health record data, I estimate model parameters and decompose the observed male∶female ADHD diagnostic difference of 2.3∶1. Simulations show that only 20%–25% of this diagnostic difference can be explained by underlying symptom prevalence, with the majority driven by differences in diagnostic thresholds. I find that physicians view missed diagnosis to be costlier for their male patients, which I argue may have economic justifications.

before.title_zh: 误诊与漏诊：医生决策与注意缺陷多动障碍
before.abstract_zh: 驱动精神卫生保健差异的机制尚未得到充分理解。本文构建了一个注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）诊断的结构模型，突出患者和医生因素如何导致差异。利用电子健康记录数据，我估计了模型参数，并分解了观察到的男性∶女性ADHD诊断差异2.3∶1。模拟显示，这一诊断差异中仅有20%–25%可由潜在症状患病率解释，其余大部分由诊断阈值差异驱动。我发现医生认为漏诊对其男性患者代价更高，我认为这可能有经济上的合理性。

existing_records.title: Mis(sed) Diagnosis: Physician Decision-Making and ADHD
existing_records.abstract: The mechanisms driving disparities in mental health care are not well understood. This paper develops a structural model of diagnosis for attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), highlighting how patient and physician factors can result in disparities. Using electronic health record data, I estimate model parameters and decompose the observed male∶female ADHD diagnostic difference of 2.3∶1. Simulations show that only 20%–25% of this diagnostic difference can be explained by underlying symptom prevalence, with the majority driven by differences in diagnostic thresholds. I find that physicians view missed diagnosis to be costlier for their male patients, which I argue may have economic justifications.

source_records.title: From Doubt to Devotion: Trials and Learning-Based Pricing
source_records.abstract: An informed seller designs a dynamic mechanism to sell an experience good. The seller has partial information about the product match, which affects the buyer's private consumption experience. We characterize equilibrium mechanisms of this dynamic informed principal problem. The belief gap between the informed seller and the uninformed buyer, coupled with the buyer's learning, gives rise to mechanisms that provide the skeptical buyer with limited access to the product and an option to upgrade if the buyer is swayed by a good experience. Depending on the seller's screening technology, this takes the form of free/discounted trials or tiered pricing, which are prevalent in digital markets. In contrast to static environments, having consumer data can reduce sellers' revenue in equilibrium, as they fine-tune the dynamic design with their data forecasting the buyer's learning process.

before.title_zh: 从怀疑到笃信：试验与基于学习的定价
before.abstract_zh: 一个知情卖方设计一种动态机制来销售一种体验品。卖方对产品匹配度拥有部分信息，而该匹配度会影响买方的私人消费体验。我们刻画了这一动态知情委托人问题的均衡机制。知情卖方与不知情买方之间的信念差距，加上买方的学习，产生了这样的机制：向持怀疑态度的买方提供有限的产品获取权，并在买方被良好体验说服时提供升级选项。取决于卖方的筛选技术，这表现为免费/折扣试用或分层定价，这些在数字市场中十分普遍。与静态环境相比，拥有消费者数据在均衡中可能降低卖方的收入，因为卖方利用其数据预测买方的学习过程，从而对动态设计进行精细调整。

source_records.title: Debiasing and t-Tests for Synthetic Control Inference on Average Causal Effects
source_records.abstract: We propose a practical and robust method for making inference on average treatment effects estimated by synthetic controls. We develop a K-fold cross-fitting procedure for bias correction. To avoid the difficult estimation of the long-run variance, inference is based on a self-normalized t-statistic, which has an asymptotically pivotal t-distribution. Our t-test is easy to implement, provably robust against misspecification, and valid with stationary and nonstationary data. It demonstrates an excellent small-sample performance in application-based simulations and performs well relative to other methods. We illustrate the usefulness of the t-test by revisiting the effect of carbon taxes on emissions.

proofs.text: Debiasing and t-Tests for Synthetic Control Inference on Average Causal Effects
Victor Chernozhukov, Kaspar Wüthrich, and Yinchu Zhu

We propose a practical and robust method for making inference on average treatment effects estimated by synthetic controls. We develop a K-fold cross-fitting procedure for bias correction. To avoid the difficult estimation of the long-run variance, inference is based on a self-normalized t-statistic, which has an asymptotically pivotal t-distribution. Our t-test is easy to implement, provably robust against misspecification, and valid with stationary and nonstationary data. It demonstrates an excellent small-sample performance in application-based simulations and performs well relative to other methods. We illustrate the usefulness of the t-test by revisiting the effect of carbon taxes on emissions.

before.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种实用且稳健的方法，用于对由合成控制估计的平均处理效应进行推断。我们开发了一种用于偏差校正的K折交叉拟合程序。为避免长期方差的困难估计，推断基于自归一化t统计量，该统计量具有渐近枢轴t分布。我们的t检验易于实施，可证明对误设定稳健，并且对平稳和非平稳数据均有效。在基于应用的模拟中，它展现出优异的小样本性能，并且相对于其他方法表现良好。我们通过重新审视碳税对排放的影响来说明t检验的实用性。

source_records.title: Optimal Tests Following Sequential Experiments
source_records.abstract: Recent years have seen tremendous advances in the theory and application of sequential experiments. While these experiments are not always designed with hypothesis testing in mind, researchers may still be interested in performing tests after the experiment is completed. The purpose of this paper is to aid in the development of optimal tests for sequential experiments by analyzing their asymptotic properties. Our key finding is that the asymptotic power function of any test can be matched by a test in a limit experiment where a Gaussian process is observed for each treatment, and inference is made for the drifts of these processes. This result has important implications, including a powerful sufficiency result: any candidate test only needs to rely on a fixed set of statistics, regardless of the type of sequential experiment. These statistics are the number of times each treatment has been sampled by the end of the experiment, along with final value of the score (for parametric models) or efficient influence function (for non-parametric models) process for each treatment. We then characterize asymptotically optimal tests under various restrictions such as unbiasedness, α-spending constraints etc. Finally, we apply our our results to three key classes of sequential experiments: costly sampling, group sequential trials, and bandit experiments, and show how optimal inference can be conducted in these scenarios.

before.title_zh: 序贯实验后的最优检验
before.abstract_zh: 近年来，序贯实验的理论与应用取得了巨大进展。尽管这些实验在设计时并不总是考虑假设检验，但研究人员可能仍对在实验完成后进行检验感兴趣。本文的目的是通过分析序贯实验的渐近性质，帮助开发最优检验。我们的关键发现是，任何检验的渐近功效函数都可以在一个极限实验中被一个检验所匹配，在该极限实验中，对每种处理观测到一个高斯过程，并针对这些过程的漂移进行推断。这一结果具有重要含义，包括一个强大的充分性结果：无论序贯实验的类型如何，任何候选检验只需依赖于一组固定的统计量。这些统计量是实验结束时每种处理被抽样的次数，以及每种处理的得分（对于参数模型）或有效影响函数（对于非参数模型）过程的最终值。然后，我们刻画了在诸如无偏性、α消耗约束等各种限制下的渐近最优检验。最后，我们将结果应用于三类关键的序贯实验：高成本抽样、成组序贯试验和老虎机实验，并展示在这些情形下如何进行最优推断。

source_records.abstract: We develop methods for inference following sequential experiments by studying the asymptotic properties of tests. We find that the large-sample power of any test can be matched by a test in a suitable limit experiment involving Gaussian diffusions. This establishes that a fixed set of statistics are asymptotically sufficient for testing; these are the number of times each treatment has been sampled and the final value of the score/efficient influence function process for each treatment. We also derive asymptotically optimal tests under various conditions and apply these findings to three types of sequential experiments: costly sampling, group sequential trials, and bandit experiments.

after.title_zh: 序贯实验后的最优检验
after.abstract_zh: 近年来，序贯实验的理论与应用取得了巨大进展。尽管这些实验在设计时并不总是考虑假设检验，但研究人员可能仍对在实验完成后进行检验感兴趣。本文的目的是通过分析序贯实验的渐近性质，帮助开发最优检验。我们的关键发现是，任何检验的渐近功效函数都可以在一个极限实验中被一个检验所匹配，在该极限实验中，对每种处理观测到一个高斯过程，并针对这些过程的漂移进行推断。这一结果具有重要含义，包括一个强大的充分性结果：无论序贯实验的类型如何，任何候选检验只需依赖于一组固定的统计量。这些统计量是实验结束时每种处理被抽样的次数，以及每种处理的得分（对于参数模型）或有效影响函数（对于非参数模型）过程的最终值。然后，我们刻画了在诸如无偏性、α消耗约束等各种限制下的渐近最优检验。最后，我们将结果应用于三类关键的序贯实验：高成本抽样、成组序贯试验和老虎机实验，并展示在这些情形下如何进行最优推断。

existing_records.title: Optimal Tests Following Sequential Experiments
existing_records.abstract: Recent years have seen tremendous advances in the theory and application of sequential experiments. While these experiments are not always designed with hypothesis testing in mind, researchers may still be interested in performing tests after the experiment is completed. The purpose of this paper is to aid in the development of optimal tests for sequential experiments by analyzing their asymptotic properties. Our key finding is that the asymptotic power function of any test can be matched by a test in a limit experiment where a Gaussian process is observed for each treatment, and inference is made for the drifts of these processes. This result has important implications, including a powerful sufficiency result: any candidate test only needs to rely on a fixed set of statistics, regardless of the type of sequential experiment. These statistics are the number of times each treatment has been sampled by the end of the experiment, along with final value of the score (for parametric models) or efficient influence function (for non-parametric models) process for each treatment. We then characterize asymptotically optimal tests under various restrictions such as unbiasedness, α-spending constraints etc. Finally, we apply our our results to three key classes of sequential experiments: costly sampling, group sequential trials, and bandit experiments, and show how optimal inference can be conducted in these scenarios.

source_records.title: Illiquid Lemon Markets and the Macroeconomy
source_records.abstract: We study the macroeconomic implications of asymmetric information in capital markets.We build a quantitative capital-accumulation model in which capital is traded in illiquid markets, with sellers having more information about capital quality than buyers.Asymmetric information distorts the terms of trade for sellers of high-quality capital, who list higher prices and are willing to accept lower trading probabilities to signal their type.Led by the model's predictions, we measure the distortions from asymmetric information by studying the relationship between listed prices and trading probabilities in a unique dataset of individual capital units listed for trade.By combining the empirical measurement with the model, we show that information asymmetries can play a quantitatively large role during economic crises when the degree of asymmetric information deteriorates.

before.title_zh: 非流动性柠檬市场与宏观经济
before.abstract_zh: 我们研究资本市场中信息不对称的宏观经济影响。我们构建了一个定量资本积累模型，其中资本在流动性不足的市场中交易，卖方比买方更了解资本质量。信息不对称扭曲了高质量资本卖方的交易条件，这些卖方会报出更高的价格，并愿意接受更低的交易概率以表明其类型。在模型预测的引导下，我们通过研究一个独特的单个资本单位挂牌交易数据集中挂牌价格与交易概率之间的关系，来衡量信息不对称造成的扭曲。通过将实证测量与模型相结合，我们表明，在经济危机期间，当信息不对称程度恶化时，信息不对称可能发挥巨大的定量作用。

We build a model in which heterogeneous capital is traded in illiquid markets, with sellers better informed about its quality than buyers. Asymmetric information distorts the terms of trade for sellers of high-quality capital, who list higher prices and accept lower trading probabilities to signal their type. Guided by the model, we measure these distortions from the relationship between listed prices and trading probabilities in a unique dataset of capital units. Combining this measurement with the model, we show that information asymmetries can play a quantitatively large role during crises, when they intensify.

source_records.title: Markups: A Search-Theoretic Perspective
source_records.abstract: I derive a formula for the equilibrium distribution of markups in the search-theoretic model of imperfect competition of Butters (1977), Varian (1980), and Burdett andJudd (1983).The level of markups and the sign of the relationship between a seller's markup and its size depends on the extent of search frictions, as well as on other deep parameters.Markups are efficient.Markups are positive even though the varieties produced by sellers are perfect substitutes.Markups are heterogeneous even when all sellers operate the same production technology.Markups depend on size, even though the substitutability between a variety and the others does not depend on how much of that variety is consumed.Interpreting these markups through the lens of the monopolistic competition model of Dixit and Stiglitz (1977) would lead one to recover incorrect and unstable buyers' preferences.Interpreting these markups through the lens of the Dixit-Stiglitz model would also leads to incorrect policy recommendations.These results are a cautionary note on recent work in macroeconomics.

before.title_zh: 加成定价：一个搜寻理论视角
before.abstract_zh: 我推导了Butters（1977）、Varian（1980）以及Burdett和Judd（1983）的不完全竞争搜寻理论模型中加成均衡分布的公式。加成的水平以及卖方加成与其规模之间关系的符号，取决于搜寻摩擦的程度以及其他深层参数。加成是有效率的。即使卖方生产的品种是完全替代品，加成也是正的。即使所有卖方采用相同的生产技术，加成也是异质的。加成取决于规模，即使某一品种与其他品种之间的可替代性并不取决于该品种的消费量。通过Dixit和Stiglitz（1977）垄断竞争模型的视角来解释这些加成，会导致得出不正确且不稳定的买方偏好。通过Dixit-Stiglitz模型的视角来解释这些加成，也会导致不正确的政策建议。这些结果是对近期宏观经济学研究的一个警示。

source_records.title: Markups: A Search-Theoretic Perspective
source_records.abstract: I characterize markups in the search-theoretic model of imperfect competition of Burdett and Judd. after.title_zh: 加成定价：一个搜寻理论视角
after.abstract_zh: 我推导了Butters（1977）、Varian（1980）以及Burdett和Judd（1983）的不完全竞争搜寻理论模型中加成均衡分布的公式。加成的水平以及卖方加成与其规模之间关系的符号，取决于搜寻摩擦的程度以及其他深层参数。加成是有效率的。即使卖方生产的品种是完全替代品，加成也是正的。即使所有卖方采用相同的生产技术，加成也是异质的。加成取决于规模，即使某一品种与其他品种之间的可替代性并不取决于该品种的消费量。通过Dixit和Stiglitz（1977）垄断竞争模型的视角来解释这些加成，会导致得出不正确且不稳定的买方偏好。通过Dixit-Stiglitz模型的视角来解释这些加成，也会导致不正确的政策建议。这些结果是对近期宏观经济学研究的一个警示。

The Power of Proximity to Coworkers

source_records.title: The Power of Proximity to Coworkres*
source_records.abstract: How does proximity to coworkers affect training and productivity? We study software engineers at a Fortune 500 firm from 2019 to 2024, leveraging two shocks to proximity: the office closures in 2020 and the subsequent return-to-office mandates in 2022 and 2023. In both cases, co-located teams experienced bigger changes in proximity than distributed ones, facilitating difference-in-differences designs. We find that sitting near teammates increases coding feedback by 18.3% and improves code quality. Gains are concentrated among less-tenured and younger employees, who are building human capital. However, there is a trade-off: experienced engineers write less code when sitting near teammates. In national U.S. data, we find evidence that the rise of remote work has had scarring effects on young college graduates. In remotable jobs, young graduates’ unemployment rate increased relative to older graduates’ post-pandemic (2022–2024) compared to pre-pandemic (2017–2019), a pattern we do not observe in non-remotable jobs.

before.title_zh: 与同事邻近的力量*
before.abstract_zh: 与同事的邻近程度如何影响培训与生产率？我们研究了2019年至2024年间一家《财富》500强企业的软件工程师，利用两次邻近程度冲击：2020年的办公室关闭以及随后2022年和2023年的重返办公室要求。在这两种情况下，同地办公团队经历的邻近程度变化都大于分布式团队，这便于采用双重差分设计。我们发现，坐在队友附近使编码反馈增加18.3%，并改善代码质量。收益集中在任职时间较短和较年轻的员工身上，他们正在积累人力资本。然而，存在一种权衡：经验丰富的工程师在坐在队友附近时编写的代码更少。在美国全国数据中，我们发现证据表明，远程办公的兴起对年轻大学毕业生产生了创伤性影响。在可远程办公的工作中，与疫情前（2017—2019年）相比，疫情后（2022—2024年）年轻毕业生的失业率相对于年长毕业生有所上升，而我们在不可远程办公的工作中未观察到这一模式。

existing_records.title: The Power of Proximity to Coworkres*
existing_records.abstract: How does proximity to coworkers affect training and productivity? We study software engineers at a Fortune 500 firm from 2019 to 2024, leveraging two shocks to proximity: the office closures in 2020 and the subsequent return-to-office mandates in 2022 and 2023. In both cases, co-located teams experienced bigger changes in proximity than distributed ones, facilitating difference-in-differences designs. We find that sitting near teammates increases coding feedback by 18.3% and improves code quality. Gains are concentrated among less-tenured and younger employees, who are building human capital. However, there is a trade-off: experienced engineers write less code when sitting near teammates. In national U.S. data, we find evidence that the rise of remote work has had scarring effects on young college graduates. In remotable jobs, young graduates’ unemployment rate increased relative to older graduates’ post-pandemic (2022–2024) compared to pre-pandemic (2017–2019), a pattern we do not observe in non-remotable jobs.

after.title_zh: 与同事邻近的力量*
after.abstract_zh: 与同事的邻近程度如何影响培训与生产率？我们研究了2019年至2024年间一家《财富》500强企业的软件工程师，利用两次邻近程度冲击：2020年的办公室关闭以及随后2022年和2023年的重返办公室要求。在这两种情况下，同地办公团队经历的邻近程度变化都大于分布式团队，这便于采用双重差分设计。我们发现，坐在队友附近使编码反馈增加18.3%，并改善代码质量。收益集中在任职时间较短和较年轻的员工身上，他们正在积累人力资本。然而，存在一种权衡：经验丰富的工程师在坐在队友附近时编写的代码更少。在美国全国数据中，我们发现证据表明，远程办公的兴起对年轻大学毕业生产生了创伤性影响。在可远程办公的工作中，与疫情前（2017—2019年）相比，疫情后（2022—2024年）年轻毕业生的失业率相对于年长毕业生有所上升，而我们在不可远程办公的工作中未观察到这一模式。

source_records.title: Making the Invisible Hand Visible: Managers and the Allocation of Workers to Jobs
source_records.abstract: Why do managers matter for firm performance? This article provides evidence of the critical role of managers in matching workers to jobs within the firm using the universe of personnel records from a large multinational firm. The data cover 200,000 white-collar workers and 30,000 managers over 11 years in 100 countries. I identify good managers by their speed of promotion and leverage exogenous variation induced by the rotation of managers across teams. I find that good managers cause workers to reallocate within the firm through lateral and vertical transfers and generate large and persistent gains in workers’ career progression and productivity. My results imply that the visible hands of managers match workers’ specific skills to specialized jobs, leading to an improvement in the productivity of existing workers that outlasts the managers’ time at the firm.

before.title_zh: 让看不见的手变得可见：管理者与工人与工作的匹配*
before.abstract_zh: 为什么管理者对企业的绩效至关重要？本文利用一家大型跨国公司的全部人事记录，提供了管理者在将员工与岗位在企业内部进行匹配方面发挥关键作用的证据。数据涵盖100个国家、11年间200,000名白领员工和30,000名管理者。我通过管理者的晋升速度来识别优秀管理者，并利用管理者在团队之间轮换所引发的外生变异。我发现，优秀管理者会促使员工通过横向和纵向调动在企业内部重新配置，并在员工的职业发展和生产率方面产生巨大且持久的收益。我的结果表明，管理者的看得见的手将员工的具体技能与专业化岗位相匹配，从而使现有员工的生产率得到提升，且这种提升在管理者离开企业后仍持续存在。

after.abstract_zh: 为什么管理者对企业的绩效至关重要？本文利用一家大型跨国公司的全部人事记录，提供了管理者在将员工与岗位在企业内部进行匹配方面发挥关键作用的证据。数据涵盖100个国家、11年间200,000名白领员工和30,000名管理者。我通过管理者的晋升速度来识别优秀管理者，并利用管理者在团队之间轮换所引发的外生变异。我发现，优秀管理者会促使员工通过横向和纵向调动在企业内部重新配置，并在员工的职业发展和生产率方面产生巨大且持久的收益。我的结果表明，管理者的看得见的手将员工的具体技能与专业化岗位相匹配，从而使现有员工的生产率得到提升，且这种提升在管理者离开企业后仍持续存在。

existing_records.title: Making the Invisible Hand Visible: Managers and the Allocation of Workers to Jobs*
existing_records.abstract: Why do managers matter for firm performance? This article provides evidence of the critical role of managers in matching workers to jobs within the firm using the universe of personnel records from a large multinational firm. The data cover 200,000 white-collar workers and 30,000 managers over 11 years in 100 countries. I identify good managers by their speed of promotion and leverage exogenous variation induced by the rotation of managers across teams. I find that good managers cause workers to reallocate within the firm through lateral and vertical transfers and generate large and persistent gains in workers’ career progression and productivity. My results imply that the visible hands of managers match workers’ specific skills to specialized jobs, leading to an improvement in the productivity of existing workers that outlasts the managers’ time at the firm.

source_records.title: Codification, Technology Absorption, and the Globalization of the Industrial Revolution
source_records.abstract: This article examines the global adoption of technology in the late nineteenth century. We construct several novel data sets to test the idea that the codification of technical knowledge in the vernacular was necessary for countries to absorb the technologies of the first Industrial Revolution. We find that comparative advantage shifted to industries that could benefit from these technologies in countries and colonies with access to codified technical knowledge, but not in other regions. Using the rapid and unprecedented codification of technical knowledge in Meiji Japan as a natural experiment, we show that this pattern emerged only after the Japanese government codified vast amounts of technical knowledge. Our findings shed new light on the frictions associated with technological diffusion and offer a novel explanation for why Meiji Japan was unique among non-Western countries in successfully industrializing during the first wave of globalization.

before.title_zh: 法典化、技术吸收与工业革命的全球化
before.abstract_zh: 本文考察了19世纪末技术的全球采用情况。我们构建了若干新的数据集，以检验这样一种观点：用本地语言对技术知识进行法典化，是各国吸收第一次工业革命技术的必要条件。我们发现，在能够获取法典化技术知识的国家和殖民地，比较优势转向了能够受益于这些技术的产业，但在其他地区则并非如此。利用明治日本对技术知识迅速且前所未有的法典化作为自然实验，我们表明这一模式只有在日本政府将大量技术知识法典化之后才出现。我们的发现为与技术扩散相关的摩擦提供了新的启示，并为明治日本为何在非西方国家中独树一帜、在第一次全球化浪潮中成功实现工业化提供了一种新的解释。

decisions.title: Technology Sophistication Across Establishments

source_records.title: Technology Sophistication Across Establishments*
source_records.abstract: We study technology sophistication using a novel approach that measures the sophistication of the most advanced (MAX) and the most widely used (MOST) technologies in key business functions within establishments. Using data from over 21,000 establishments across 15 countries, we find that establishments generally underutilize the most sophisticated technologies available in a business function. These MAX-MOST gaps are persistent and strongly associated with productivity both across establishments and countries. At the establishment level, there is substantial variation in both MAX and MOST, with MOST showing a more skewed distribution. MAX and MOST follow different life cycle patterns in low-income countries and among small establishments, and they exhibit different associations with several establishment characteristics and performance indicators. This evidence underscores the different nature of the technology upgrading processes that drive MAX and MOST.

before.title_zh: 各机构间的技术复杂度*
before.abstract_zh: 我们采用一种新颖方法研究技术复杂度，该方法衡量各机构关键业务职能中最先进（MAX）与最广泛使用（MOST）技术的复杂度。利用来自15个国家超过21,000家机构的数据，我们发现机构通常未充分利用某一业务职能中可用的最先进技术。这些MAX-MOST差距具有持续性，并与机构层面和国家层面的生产率均强烈相关。在机构层面，MAX和MOST均存在显著差异，其中MOST的分布更为偏斜。在低收入国家和小型机构中，MAX和MOST遵循不同的生命周期模式，并且它们与若干机构特征和绩效指标表现出不同的关联。这些证据凸显了驱动MAX和MOST的技术升级过程具有不同性质。

existing_records.title: Technology Sophistication Across Establishments*
existing_records.abstract: We study technology sophistication using a novel approach that measures the sophistication of the most advanced (MAX) and the most widely used (MOST) technologies in key business functions within establishments. Using data from over 21,000 establishments across 15 countries, we find that establishments generally underutilize the most sophisticated technologies available in a business function. These MAX-MOST gaps are persistent and strongly associated with productivity both across establishments and countries. At the establishment level, there is substantial variation in both MAX and MOST, with MOST showing a more skewed distribution. MAX and MOST follow different life cycle patterns in low-income countries and among small establishments, and they exhibit different associations with several establishment characteristics and performance indicators. This evidence underscores the different nature of the technology upgrading processes that drive MAX and MOST.

source_records.title: “Compensate the Losers?” Economic Policy and the Origins of U.S. Partisan Realignment*
source_records.abstract: We argue that the Democratic Party’s evolution on economic policy helps explain partisan realignment by education. First, we document that educated Americans differentially oppose “predistribution” (e.g., job guarantees, higher minimum wages, protectionism, and stronger unions), while the educational gradient for redistribution (taxes and transfers) is close to zero. These relationships have been largely unchanged since the 1940s. Second, focusing on politicians and donors as key party actors, we show that the Democratic Party has moved away from predistribution since the 1970s. The number of predistribution bills introduced by Democratic House Speakers has declined by half since the 1970s. Unions—the traditional lobbying force for predistribution—see their share of Democratic Party PAC donations decline from 90% to 40% from 1968 to 1980, following 1970s legislation that facilitated corporate PAC donations. From 1980 onward, the Democrats rely increasingly on individual contributions from educated donors relative to the Republicans. We show the increased reliance on corporate PACs and educated donors is driven by the rise of a self-described “New Democrat’’ faction particularly conservative on predistribution and social issues. Finally, we trace the reaction of voters to these changes in the Democratic Party. Less-educated Americans begin to leave the party in the 1970s, after decades of serving as its base. We also show that in the crucial transition period of the 1970s through 1990s, New Democrat candidates outperform other Democrats among more-educated voters in both survey questions and actual Congressional elections. As the New Democrats are more socially conservative than other Democrats, their success with educated voters suggests that social issues alone cannot explain educational realignment.

existing_records.title: “Compensate the Losers?” Economic Policy and the Origins of U.S. Partisan Realignment*
existing_records.abstract: We argue that the Democratic Party’s evolution on economic policy helps explain partisan realignment by education. First, we document that educated Americans differentially oppose “predistribution” (e.g., job guarantees, higher minimum wages, protectionism, and stronger unions), while the educational gradient for redistribution (taxes and transfers) is close to zero. These relationships have been largely unchanged since the 1940s. Second, focusing on politicians and donors as key party actors, we show that the Democratic Party has moved away from predistribution since the 1970s. The number of predistribution bills introduced by Democratic House Speakers has declined by half since the 1970s. Unions—the traditional lobbying force for predistribution—see their share of Democratic Party PAC donations decline from 90% to 40% from 1968 to 1980, following 1970s legislation that facilitated corporate PAC donations. From 1980 onward, the Democrats rely increasingly on individual contributions from educated donors relative to the Republicans. We show the increased reliance on corporate PACs and educated donors is driven by the rise of a self-described “New Democrat’’ faction particularly conservative on predistribution and social issues. Finally, we trace the reaction of voters to these changes in the Democratic Party. Less-educated Americans begin to leave the party in the 1970s, after decades of serving as its base. We also show that in the crucial transition period of the 1970s through 1990s, New Democrat candidates outperform other Democrats among more-educated voters in both survey questions and actual Congressional elections. As the New Democrats are more socially conservative than other Democrats, their success with educated voters suggests that social issues alone cannot explain educational realignment.

source_records.abstract: This article examines how the American Medical Association (AMA) helped shape the development of the U.S. health insurance system in the critical period after World War II. Working with the political public relations firm Campaigns, Inc., the AMA launched a nationwide campaign to weaken support for national health insurance by framing it as “socialized medicine,” while simultaneously enrolling people in private health insurance plans to shift demand away from a public alternative. Drawing on newly assembled archival data, we find that greater exposure to the campaign explains about 20% of the rise in private health insurance enrollment and a comparable decline in public support for a national program. These findings suggest that the rise of private health insurance in the United States was not solely due to macroeconomic forces or collective bargaining; rather, it was also enabled by a strategic, interest group–financed effort to shape citizen views and influence policy.

before.title_zh: 为什么美国没有国家医疗保险？美国医学会的政治角色
before.abstract_zh: 本文考察了美国医学会（AMA）在二战后关键时期如何帮助塑造美国医疗保险体系的发展。美国医学会与政治公共关系公司Campaigns, Inc.合作，发起了一场全国性运动，通过将国家医疗保险框定为“社会化医疗”来削弱对其的支持，同时让人们加入私人医疗保险计划，从而将需求从公共替代方案上转移开。利用新整理的档案数据，我们发现，对该运动的更大暴露程度解释了私人医疗保险参保率上升的约20%，以及公众对国家计划支持率的相当下降。该运动似乎还通过协调一致的信息传递、公民组织通过的决议、国会言论和政治捐款影响了政策制定。这些发现表明，美国私人医疗保险的兴起并非仅仅源于宏观经济力量或集体谈判；相反，它还得益于一场由利益集团资助的、旨在塑造公民观点并影响政策的战略性努力。

existing_records.title: Why Doesn’t the United States Have National Health Insurance? The Political Role of the American Medical Association
existing_records.abstract: This article examines how the American Medical Association (AMA) helped shape the development of the U.S. health insurance system in the critical period after World War II. Working with the political public relations firm Campaigns, Inc., the AMA launched a nationwide campaign to weaken support for national health insurance by framing it as “socialized medicine,” while simultaneously enrolling people in private health insurance plans to shift demand away from a public alternative. Drawing on newly assembled archival data, we find that greater exposure to the campaign explains about 20% of the rise in private health insurance enrollment and a comparable decline in public support for a national program. The campaign also appears to have influenced policy making through coordinated messaging, resolutions passed by civic organizations, congressional rhetoric, and political donations. These findings suggest that the rise of private health insurance in the United States was not solely due to macroeconomic forces or collective bargaining; rather, it was also enabled by a strategic, interest group–financed effort to shape citizen views and influence policy.

decisions.title: The Effects of Mandatory Profit-Sharing on Workers and Firms: Evidence from France

source_records.title: The Effects of Mandatory Profit-Sharing on Workers and Firms: Evidence from France
source_records.abstract: Since 1967, all French firms with more than 100 employees have been required to share a fraction of their excess profits with their employees. Through this scheme, firms with excess profits distribute, on average, 10.5% of their pretax income to workers. In 1990, the eligibility threshold was reduced to 50 employees. We exploit this regulatory change to identify the effects of mandated profit-sharing on firms and their employees. The cost of mandated profit-sharing for firms is evident in the significant bunching at the 100-employee threshold observed prior to the reform, which completely disappears post-reform. Using a difference-in-differences strategy, we find that at the firm level, mandated profit-sharing (i) increases the labor share by 1.8 percentage points, (ii) reduces the profit share by 1.4 percentage points, and (iii) has small to nonexistent effects on investment and productivity. At the employee level, mandated profit-sharing increases lower-skilled workers’ total compensation and leaves high-skilled workers’ total compensation unchanged. Overall, mandated profit-sharing redistributes excess profits to lower-skilled workers in the firm without generating significant distortions or productivity effects.

before.title_zh: 强制性利润分享对工人和企业的影响：来自法国的证据
before.abstract_zh: 自1967年以来，所有员工超过100人的法国企业都必须与员工分享一部分超额利润。通过该计划，拥有超额利润的企业平均将税前收入的10.5%分配给工人。1990年，适用门槛降至50名员工。我们利用这一监管变化来识别强制性利润分享对企业及其员工的影响。强制性利润分享对企业的成本在改革前观察到的100名员工门槛处的显著堆积中显而易见，而这一堆积在改革后完全消失。使用双重差分策略，我们发现在企业层面，强制性利润分享(i)使劳动份额提高1.8个百分点，(ii)使利润份额降低1.4个百分点，(iii)对投资和生产率的影响很小甚至不存在。在员工层面，强制性利润分享提高了低技能工人的总薪酬，而高技能工人的总薪酬保持不变。总体而言，强制性利润分享将企业中的超额利润再分配给低技能工人，而没有产生显著的扭曲或生产率效应。

decisions.title: International Reserve Management Under Rollover Crises

source_records.title: International Reserve Management Under Rollover Crises*
source_records.abstract: This article investigates how a government should manage international reserves when it faces the risk of a rollover crisis. We ask: Should the government accumulate reserves or reduce debt to make itself less vulnerable? We show that the optimal policy entails initially reducing debt, followed by a subsequent increase in both debt and reserves as the government approaches a safe zone. Furthermore, we find that issuing additional debt to accumulate reserves can lead to a reduction in sovereign spreads. Evidence from a panel of emerging economies is consistent with these predictions: increases in reserves financed by public external borrowing are associated with lower spreads, and reserve holdings are not systematically drawn down during crisis episodes.

before.title_zh: 展期危机下的国际储备管理*
before.abstract_zh: 本文研究政府在面临展期危机风险时应如何管理国际储备。我们提出：政府应积累储备还是减少债务以降低自身脆弱性？我们表明，最优政策最初是减少债务，随后在政府接近安全区时同时增加债务和储备。此外，我们发现，发行额外债务以积累储备可以导致主权利差下降。来自一组新兴经济体面板数据的证据与这些预测一致：由公共外部借款融资的储备增加与较低的利差相关，且在危机期间储备持有量并未被系统性地提取。

We ask: Should the government accumulate reserves or reduce debt to make itself less vulnerable? We show that the optimal policy entails initially reducing debt, followed by a subsequent increase in both debt and reserves as the government approaches a safe zone. Furthermore, we find that issuing additional debt to accumulate reserves can lead to a reduction in sovereign spreads. Evidence from a panel of emerging economies is consistent with these predictions: increases in reserves financed by public external borrowing are associated with lower spreads, and reserve holdings are not systematically drawn down during crisis episodes.

after.title_zh: 展期危机下的国际储备管理*
after.abstract_zh: 本文研究政府在面临展期危机风险时应如何管理国际储备。我们提出：政府应积累储备还是减少债务以降低自身脆弱性？我们表明，最优政策最初是减少债务，随后在政府接近安全区时同时增加债务和储备。此外，我们发现，发行额外债务以积累储备可以导致主权利差下降。来自一组新兴经济体面板数据的证据与这些预测一致：由公共外部借款融资的储备增加与较低的利差相关，且在危机期间储备持有量并未被系统性地提取。

source_records.title: Business, Liquidity, and Information Cycles
source_records.abstract: Stock markets play a dual role: they provide information about firms’ fundamentals, which improves resource allocations, and they provide liquidity. We propose a setting in which these two roles interact: if stocks are used more intensively for liquidity, then prices reveal less information about fundamentals. We structurally estimate stock price informativeness for several countries and show that it declines when alternative liquidity sources, such as banks, are in distress. To study the real effects of this mechanism, we devise a strategy to integrate our stock-trading module into a dynamic general equilibrium model with heterogeneous firms. We calibrate the model to the United States and simulate recessions with and without banking distress. In a standalone recession, prices become more informative and allocation improves, mitigating output losses by 4.4%. If the recession coincides with banking distress, agents rely more on stock markets to obtain liquidity, prices become less informative, and allocation deteriorates, magnifying output losses by 22%.

before.title_zh: 商业、流动性与信息周期*
before.abstract_zh: 股票市场发挥双重作用：它们提供关于公司基本面的信息，从而改善资源配置，同时它们也提供流动性。我们提出一个这两种作用相互影响的设定：如果股票被更密集地用于流动性目的，那么价格所揭示的关于基本面的信息就会减少。我们对若干国家的股价信息含量进行结构估计，并表明当银行等替代性流动性来源陷入困境时，股价信息含量会下降。为研究这一机制的实体效应，我们设计了一种策略，将我们的股票交易模块整合到一个包含异质性企业的动态一般均衡模型中。我们将模型校准至美国，并模拟有银行困境和无银行困境两种情况下的衰退。在单独发生的衰退中，价格变得更具信息含量，配置得到改善，将产出损失减轻4.4%。如果衰退与银行困境同时发生，代理人更多地依赖股票市场获取流动性，价格变得不那么具有信息含量，配置恶化，将产出损失放大22%。

after.title_original: Business, Liquidity, and Information Cycles
after.abstract_original: Stock markets play a dual role: they provide information about firms’ fundamentals, which improves resource allocations, and they provide liquidity. We propose a setting in which these two roles interact: if stocks are used more intensively for liquidity, then prices reveal less information about fundamentals. We structurally estimate stock price informativeness for several countries and show that it declines when alternative liquidity sources, such as banks, are in distress. To study the real effects of this mechanism, we devise a strategy to integrate our stock-trading module into a dynamic general equilibrium model with heterogeneous firms. We calibrate the model to the United States and simulate recessions with and without banking distress. In a standalone recession, prices become more informative and allocation improves, mitigating output losses by 4.4%. If the recession coincides with banking distress, agents rely more on stock markets to obtain liquidity, prices become less informative, and allocation deteriorates, magnifying output losses by 22%.
after.title_zh: 商业、流动性与信息周期*
after.abstract_zh: 股票市场发挥双重作用：它们提供关于公司基本面的信息，从而改善资源配置，同时它们也提供流动性。我们提出一个这两种作用相互影响的设定：如果股票被更密集地用于流动性目的，那么价格所揭示的关于基本面的信息就会减少。我们对若干国家的股价信息含量进行结构估计，并表明当银行等替代性流动性来源陷入困境时，股价信息含量会下降。为研究这一机制的实体效应，我们设计了一种策略，将我们的股票交易模块整合到一个包含异质性企业的动态一般均衡模型中。我们将模型校准至美国，并模拟有银行困境和无银行困境两种情况下的衰退。在单独发生的衰退中，价格变得更具信息含量，配置得到改善，将产出损失减轻4.4%。如果衰退与银行困境同时发生，代理人更多地依赖股票市场获取流动性，价格变得不那么具有信息含量，配置恶化，将产出损失放大22%。

decisions.title: Praying for Rain

source_records.title: Praying for Rain
source_records.abstract: We study rainmaking as an instrumental religious belief. We present a model in which a religious leader tries to persuade people to believe. Praying for rain can persuade only where the hazard of rainfall during a dry spell is increasing over time, so that prayer is most likely to succeed when people most want rain. We present evidence from prayers for rain in Murcia, Spain, where the hazard rate is increasing, that the church’s prayers for rain predict rainfall over two centuries. To generalize this finding, we gather an original data set of whether ethnic groups around the world traditionally prayed for rain. We find that ethnic groups facing an increasing rainfall hazard are 47% more likely to pray for rain, consistent with our model’s prediction that societies are more likely to pray for rain where prayer is persuasive.

before.title_zh: 求雨*
before.abstract_zh: 我们将求雨作为一种工具性宗教信仰加以研究。我们提出一个模型，其中宗教领袖试图说服人们相信。求雨只有在干旱期降雨风险随时间上升的地方才具有说服力，因此当人们最渴望降雨时，祈祷最有可能成功。我们提供了来自西班牙穆尔西亚求雨的证据，那里的风险率正在上升，教会的求雨祈祷在两个世纪内预测了降雨。为推广这一发现，我们收集了一个关于世界各地族群传统上是否求雨的原创数据集。我们发现，面临降雨风险上升的族群求雨的可能性高出47%，这与我们模型的预测一致，即社会在祈祷具有说服力的地方更有可能求雨。

existing_records.title: Praying for Rain*
existing_records.abstract: We study rainmaking as an instrumental religious belief. We present a model in which a religious leader tries to persuade people to believe. Praying for rain can persuade only where the hazard of rainfall during a dry spell is increasing over time, so that prayer is most likely to succeed when people most want rain. We present evidence from prayers for rain in Murcia, Spain, where the hazard rate is increasing, that the church’s prayers for rain predict rainfall over two centuries. To generalize this finding, we gather an original data set of whether ethnic groups around the world traditionally prayed for rain. We find that ethnic groups facing an increasing rainfall hazard are 47% more likely to pray for rain, consistent with our model’s prediction that societies are more likely to pray for rain where prayer is persuasive.

source_records.title: The Effects of Gender Integration on Men: Evidence from the U.S. Military
source_records.abstract: Do men negatively respond when women first enter an occupation? We answer this question by studying the end of one of the final explicit occupational barriers to women in the United States: in 2016, the U.S. military opened all positions to women, including historically male-only combat occupations. We exploit the staggered integration of women into combat units to estimate the causal effects of the introduction of female colleagues on men’s job performance, behavior, and perceptions of workplace quality, using monthly administrative personnel records and rich survey responses. We find that integrating women into previously all-male units does not negatively affect men’s performance or behavioral outcomes, including retention, promotions, demotions, separations for misconduct, criminal investigations, and medical conditions. Most of our results are precise enough to rule out small detrimental effects. However, there is a wedge between men’s perceptions and performance. The integration of women causes a negative shift in male soldiers’ perceptions of workplace quality. The decline is driven by units integrated with female officers, likely arising from female officers increasing men’s awareness of workplace problems or from men’s dissatisfaction from working with women in positions of authority—even though men in such units show some performance gains. If male-dominated workplaces are reluctant to incorporate women due to expectations that men will become less productive, our paper provides evidence to weigh against that notion.

before.title_zh: 性别融合对男性的影响：来自美国军队的证据
before.abstract_zh: 当女性首次进入某一职业时，男性是否会做出负面反应？我们通过研究美国最后几项针对女性的明确职业障碍之一的终结来回答这个问题：2016年，美国军队向女性开放了所有岗位，包括历史上仅限男性的战斗职业。我们利用女性分批融入作战部队这一交错过程，使用月度行政人事记录和丰富的调查回复，估计女性同事的引入对男性工作绩效、行为以及工作场所质量感知的因果影响。我们发现，将女性融入此前全男性的单位不会对男性的绩效或行为结果产生负面影响，包括留任、晋升、降职、因不当行为离职、刑事调查和医疗状况。我们的大多数结果足够精确，可以排除小的不利影响。然而，男性的感知与绩效之间存在一道鸿沟。女性的融入导致男性士兵对工作场所质量的感知发生负面转变。这种下降是由融入女性军官的单位所驱动的，可能源于女性军官提高了男性对工作场所问题的意识，或者源于男性对与处于权威职位的女性共事的不满——尽管此类单位中的男性表现出一些绩效提升。如果男性主导的工作场所因预期男性会变得不那么高效而不愿接纳女性，我们的论文提供了证据来反驳这一观念。

existing_records.abstract: Do men negatively respond when women first enter an occupation? We answer this question by studying the end of one of the final explicit occupational barriers to women in the United States: in 2016, the U.S. military opened all positions to women, including historically male-only combat occupations. We exploit the staggered integration of women into combat units to estimate the causal effects of the introduction of female colleagues on men’s job performance, behavior, and perceptions of workplace quality, using monthly administrative personnel records and rich survey responses. We find that integrating women into previously all-male units does not negatively affect men’s performance or behavioral outcomes, including retention, promotions, demotions, separations for misconduct, criminal investigations, and medical conditions. Most of our results are precise enough to rule out small detrimental effects. However, there is a wedge between men’s perceptions and performance. The integration of women causes a negative shift in male soldiers’ perceptions of workplace quality. The decline is driven by units integrated with female officers, likely arising from female officers increasing men’s awareness of workplace problems or from men’s dissatisfaction from working with women in positions of authority—even though men in such units show some performance gains. If male-dominated workplaces are reluctant to incorporate women due to expectations that men will become less productive, our paper provides evidence to weigh against that notion.

after.title_zh: 性别融合对男性的影响：来自美国军队的证据
after.abstract_zh: 当女性首次进入某一职业时，男性是否会做出负面反应？我们通过研究美国最后几项针对女性的明确职业障碍之一的终结来回答这个问题：2016年，美国军队向女性开放了所有岗位，包括历史上仅限男性的战斗职业。我们利用女性分批融入作战部队这一交错过程，使用月度行政人事记录和丰富的调查回复，估计女性同事的引入对男性工作绩效、行为以及工作场所质量感知的因果影响。我们发现，将女性融入此前全男性的单位不会对男性的绩效或行为结果产生负面影响，包括留任、晋升、降职、因不当行为离职、刑事调查和医疗状况。我们的大多数结果足够精确，可以排除小的不利影响。然而，男性的感知与绩效之间存在一道鸿沟。女性的融入导致男性士兵对工作场所质量的感知发生负面转变。这种下降是由融入女性军官的单位所驱动的，可能源于女性军官提高了男性对工作场所问题的意识，或者源于男性对与处于权威职位的女性共事的不满——尽管此类单位中的男性表现出一些绩效提升。如果男性主导的工作场所因预期男性会变得不那么高效而不愿接纳女性，我们的论文提供了证据来反驳这一观念。

decisions.title: Peer Effects and the Gender Gap in Corporate Leadership: Evidence from MBA Students

source_records.title: Peer Effects and the Gender Gap in Corporate Leadership: Evidence from MBA Students*
source_records.abstract: Women continue to be underrepresented in corporate leadership positions. This article studies the role of social connections in women’s career advancement. We investigate whether access to a larger share of female peers in business school affects the gender gap in senior managerial positions. Merging administrative data from a top 10 U.S. business school with public LinkedIn profiles, we first document that female MBAs are 24% less likely than male MBAs to enter senior management within 15 years of graduation. Next we use the exogenous assignment of students into sections to show that a larger proportion of female MBA section peers increases the likelihood of entering senior management for women but not for men. This effect is driven by female-friendly firms, such as those with more generous maternity leave policies and greater work-schedule flexibility. A larger proportion of female MBA peers induces women to transition to these firms where they attain senior management roles. A survey of female MBA alumnae reveals three key mechanisms: (i) information sharing, especially related to gender-specific advice, (ii) higher ambitions and self-confidence, and (iii) increasing support from male MBA peers. These findings highlight the role of social connections in reducing the gender gap in senior management positions.

before.title_zh: 同伴效应与企业领导层中的性别差距：来自MBA学生的证据*
before.abstract_zh: 女性在企业领导职位中仍然代表性不足。本文研究社会关系在女性职业晋升中的作用。我们考察在商学院中接触更大比例的女性同伴是否会影响高级管理职位中的性别差距。我们将一所美国排名前10的商学院的行政数据与公开的LinkedIn个人资料合并，首先记录到女性MBA毕业生在毕业后15年内进入高级管理层的可能性比男性MBA毕业生低24%。接下来，我们利用学生被外生分配到班级的情况表明，女性MBA班级同伴比例较高会增加女性进入高级管理层的可能性，但不会增加男性的可能性。这一效应是由对女性友好的公司驱动的，例如那些拥有更慷慨的产假政策和更大工作日程灵活性的公司。女性MBA同伴比例较高会促使女性转向这些公司，并在那里获得高级管理职位。一项对女性MBA女校友的调查揭示了三个关键机制：(i) 信息共享，尤其是与性别特定建议相关的信息共享，(ii) 更高的抱负和自信，以及(iii) 来自男性MBA同伴的支持增加。这些发现凸显了社会关系在缩小高级管理职位性别差距中的作用。

after.abstract_zh: 女性在企业领导职位中仍然代表性不足。本文研究社会关系在女性职业晋升中的作用。我们考察在商学院中接触更大比例的女性同伴是否会影响高级管理职位中的性别差距。我们将一所美国排名前10的商学院的行政数据与公开的LinkedIn个人资料合并，首先记录到女性MBA毕业生在毕业后15年内进入高级管理层的可能性比男性MBA毕业生低24%。接下来，我们利用学生被外生分配到班级的情况表明，女性MBA班级同伴比例较高会增加女性进入高级管理层的可能性，但不会增加男性的可能性。这一效应是由对女性友好的公司驱动的，例如那些拥有更慷慨的产假政策和更大工作日程灵活性的公司。女性MBA同伴比例较高会促使女性转向这些公司，并在那里获得高级管理职位。一项对女性MBA女校友的调查揭示了三个关键机制：(i) 信息共享，尤其是与性别特定建议相关的信息共享，(ii) 更高的抱负和自信，以及(iii) 来自男性MBA同伴的支持增加。这些发现凸显了社会关系在缩小高级管理职位性别差距中的作用。

existing_records.title: Peer Effects and the Gender Gap in Corporate Leadership: Evidence from MBA Students*
existing_records.abstract: Women continue to be underrepresented in corporate leadership positions. This article studies the role of social connections in women’s career advancement. We investigate whether access to a larger share of female peers in business school affects the gender gap in senior managerial positions. Merging administrative data from a top 10 U.S. business school with public LinkedIn profiles, we first document that female MBAs are 24% less likely than male MBAs to enter senior management within 15 years of graduation. Next we use the exogenous assignment of students into sections to show that a larger proportion of female MBA section peers increases the likelihood of entering senior management for women but not for men. This effect is driven by female-friendly firms, such as those with more generous maternity leave policies and greater work-schedule flexibility. A larger proportion of female MBA peers induces women to transition to these firms where they attain senior management roles. A survey of female MBA alumnae reveals three key mechanisms: (i) information sharing, especially related to gender-specific advice, (ii) higher ambitions and self-confidence, and (iii) increasing support from male MBA peers. These findings highlight the role of social connections in reducing the gender gap in senior management positions.

decisions.title: Collusion with Optimal Information Disclosure

source_records.title: Collusion with Optimal Information Disclosure*
source_records.abstract: Motivated by recent concerns surrounding the use of third-party pricing algorithms by competing firms, we study repeated Bertrand competition where market demand or the cost of serving the market is observed by an intermediary (or “algorithm”) that selectively discloses demand or cost information to maximize firms’ collusive profit. We show that an upper censorship disclosure policy is optimal, which leads to price rigidity and supra-monopoly prices in some states. Improving the algorithm’s accuracy reduces expected consumer surplus whenever it does so under monopoly pricing. When the state is positively correlated over time, the algorithm discloses more information when recent demand was lower or costs were higher. The analysis extends to a generalized model that accommodates product differentiation and capacity constraints. We relate our findings to recent antitrust cases.

before.title_zh: 最优信息披露下的合谋*
before.abstract_zh: 受近期关于竞争企业使用第三方定价算法的担忧启发，我们研究重复伯特兰竞争，其中市场需求或服务市场的成本由一个中介（或“算法”）观察，该中介选择性地披露需求或成本信息以最大化企业的合谋利润。我们证明，上截断披露政策是最优的，这导致价格刚性和某些状态下的超垄断价格。提高算法的准确性会降低预期消费者剩余，只要它在垄断定价下也如此。当状态随时间正相关时，当近期需求较低或成本较高时，算法披露更多信息。该分析扩展到一个广义模型，该模型容纳产品差异化和产能约束。我们将我们的发现与近期的反垄断案件联系起来。

decisions.title: Public Services Under Private Management

source_records.title: Public Services Under Private Management
source_records.abstract: Theory predicts that outsourcing public services to the private sector can reduce costs and improve efficiency but can also induce cost-cutting and compromise quality. We assess the Brazilian Organizações Sociais de Saude model (OSS), which outsources management of public hospital services to the private sector while the state remains the residual claimant. We show that this enhances hospital production and operational efficiency without adverse effects on hospital quality and equity. Increased inpatient production addresses previously unmet demand, expanding local access to hospital care and reducing population mortality. Performance gains arise from improved operational efficiency achieved through increased hospital management capacity. This facilitates staffing adjustments, favoring higher-skilled personnel, dismissing lower-productivity staff, and adopting flexible, performance-tied employment contracts. Effects are larger among private organizations with more management experience, underscoring returns to managerial capacity. Our findings show that incentive-ownership structures can address the quantity-quality trade-off in public service delivery, even when contracts are incomplete and quality is hard to measure.

source_records.title: Markups Across Space and Time
source_records.abstract: In this article, we provide direct evidence on the behaviour of markups in the retail sector across space and time. Markups are measured using gross margins. We consider three levels of aggregation: the retail sector as a whole, the firm, and the product level. We find that: (1) markups are relatively stable over time and mildly procyclical; (2) there is a large regional dispersion in markups; (3) there is a positive cross-sectional correlation between local income and local markups; and (4) differences in markups across regions result from differences in the assortment of goods sold in different regions, not from deviations from uniform pricing. We propose a simple model consistent with these facts.

before.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们提供了关于零售部门加成率在空间和时间上行为的直接证据。加成率使用毛利率来衡量。我们考虑三个加总层次：整个零售部门、企业以及产品层面。我们发现：（1）加成率随时间相对稳定，且呈轻度顺周期性；（2）加成率存在较大的区域离散度；（3）当地收入与当地加成率之间存在正向的横截面相关性；（4）区域间加成率的差异源于不同区域所售商品组合的差异，而非源于对统一定价的偏离。我们提出了一个与这些事实相符的简单模型。

In this article, we provide direct evidence on the behaviour of markups in the retail sector across space and time. Markups are measured using gross margins. We consider three levels of aggregation: the retail sector as a whole, the firm, and the product level. We find that: (1) markups are relatively stable over time and mildly procyclical; (2) there is a large regional dispersion in markups; (3) there is a positive cross-sectional correlation between local income and local markups; and (4) differences in markups across regions result from differences in the assortment of goods sold in different regions, not from deviations from uniform pricing. We propose a simple model consistent with these facts.

after.title_zh: 跨空间与时间的加成率
after.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们提供了关于零售部门加成率在空间和时间上行为的直接证据。加成率使用毛利率来衡量。我们考虑三个加总层次：整个零售部门、企业以及产品层面。我们发现：（1）加成率随时间相对稳定，且呈轻度顺周期性；（2）加成率存在较大的区域离散度；（3）当地收入与当地加成率之间存在正向的横截面相关性；（4）区域间加成率的差异源于不同区域所售商品组合的差异，而非源于对统一定价的偏离。我们提出了一个与这些事实相符的简单模型。

source_records.title: The Macroeconomics of Irreversibility
source_records.abstract: We study aggregate capital dynamics in an investment model with idiosyncratic productivity shocks, fixed capital adjustment costs, and irreversibility driven by a wedge between capital purchase and resale prices. We derive sufficient statistics that capture the role of investment frictions in aggregate capital fluctuations, measure these statistics using investment microdata, and exploit them to discipline the capital price wedge. Irreversibility doubles the persistence of capital fluctuations and is crucial for reconciling micro-level investment behaviour with macroeconomic propagation.

before.title_zh: 不可逆性的宏观经济学
before.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个投资模型中的总量资本动态，该模型包含异质性生产率冲击、固定资本调整成本，以及由资本购买价格与转售价格之间的楔子所驱动的不可逆性。我们推导出充分统计量，用以刻画投资摩擦在总量资本波动中的作用，利用投资微观数据度量这些统计量，并借助它们来约束资本价格楔子。不可逆性使资本波动的持续性翻倍，并且对于调和微观层面的投资行为与宏观经济传导至关重要。

existing_records.title: The Macroeconomics of Irreversibility
existing_records.abstract: We study aggregate capital dynamics in an investment model with idiosyncratic productivity shocks, fixed capital adjustment costs, and irreversibility driven by a wedge between capital purchase and resale prices. We derive sufficient statistics that capture the role of investment frictions in aggregate capital fluctuations, measure these statistics using investment microdata, and exploit them to discipline the capital price wedge. Irreversibility doubles the persistence of capital fluctuations and is crucial for reconciling micro-level investment behaviour with macroeconomic propagation.

source_records.abstract: I examine the impact of patent term on R&D and innovation in the presence of policy anticipation, common in real-world settings. Using a difference-in-difference design, I exploit quasi-experimental variation in US patent term across technological fields due to the ratification of TRIPs agreements in 1995. source_records.raw_abstract:
Abstract
I examine the impact of patent term on R&D and innovation in the presence of policy anticipation, common in real-world settings. Using a difference-in-difference design, I exploit quasi-experimental variation in US patent term across technological fields due to the ratification of TRIPs agreements in 1995. Despite a general increase in average patent term, in most fields innovators faced a considerable probability of patent term reduction for future innovations. Three key findings emerge: (1) R&D and innovation accelerate more in fields with a higher probability of patent term reduction, i.e. a shorter average patent term extension, before implementation. (2) This heightened activity persists for at least 5 years postimplementation, driven by indirect effects where the news-related acceleration fosters further innovation through technological externalities linked to cumulative knowledge creation. (3) Conversely, the direct effect of a shorter extension in patent term would stimulate relatively less innovation, absent the indirect effects of anticipation.

before.title_zh: 专利期限、创新与技术披露外部性的作用
before.abstract_zh: 我考察在存在政策预期（现实世界中常见）的情况下，专利期限对研发与创新的影响。采用双重差分设计，我利用1995年TRIPs协定批准所导致的美国专利期限在各技术领域中的准实验变异。尽管平均专利期限总体上升，但在大多数领域中，创新者对未来创新面临专利期限被缩短的相当大可能性。得出三个关键发现：（1）在实施前，专利期限被缩短概率更高（即平均专利期限延长更短）的领域中，研发与创新加速更多。（2）这种增强的活动在实施后至少持续5年，其驱动因素是间接效应：与消息相关的加速通过与技术外部性相联系的累积性知识创造，促进了进一步创新。（3）相反，若不存在预期的间接效应，专利期限延长更短所带来的直接效应将刺激相对较少的创新。

decisions.title: Diversification, Market Entry, and the Global Internet Backbone

source_records.title: Diversification, Market Entry, and the Global Internet Backbone
source_records.abstract: In many industries, buyers diversify their supplier base to manage supplier disruption risk. We investigate the importance of such diversification as a determinant of demand and supplier entry in the context of the internet backbone, the worldwide network of undersea fibre-optic cables that underpins the internet. We specify a model of international bandwidth demand and cable operators’ dynamic entry and supply choices. The model is estimated using novel data on cross-border data flows, prices, cable characteristics, and disruptions. Counterfactual analysis reveals that supplier diversification accounts for a large share of entry and surplus created between 2005 and 2021. Relative to the socially optimal level of entry, distortions due to suppliers’ inability to capture fully the social benefits of diversity are as large as distortions due to business stealing.

source_records.title: Inflation Risk and the Finance-Growth Nexus
source_records.abstract: When firms finance using long-term nominal debt issued by financial intermediaries, changes in expected inflation lead to a wealth transfer across sectors. Higher expected inflation decreases firms’ real liabilities and default risk, which helps reduce debt overhang. However, it hurts intermediaries’ real assets, leading to a contraction in credit supply. We theoretically demonstrate that intermediary financing conditions play a key role in the transmission of nominal shocks, influencing the premium investors require for bearing inflation risk. We provide empirical evidence supporting our novel inflation transmission mechanism and connect our findings to the banking stress of 2023. We also show that Taylor rules responding to both financial and real variables can help stabilise our economy.

before.title_zh: 通胀风险与金融-增长关联
before.abstract_zh: 当企业通过金融中介发行的长期名义债务进行融资时，预期通胀的变化会导致跨部门的财富转移。较高的预期通胀会降低企业的实际负债和违约风险，这有助于减轻债务积压。然而，它会损害中介机构的实际资产，导致信贷供给收缩。我们从理论上证明，中介融资条件在名义冲击的传导中发挥关键作用，影响投资者为承担通胀风险所要求的溢价。我们提供了支持我们这一新颖通胀传导机制的经验证据，并将我们的发现与2023年的银行业压力联系起来。我们还表明，同时对金融变量和实际变量作出反应的泰勒规则有助于稳定我们的经济。

after.title_zh: 通胀风险与金融-增长关联
after.abstract_zh: 当企业通过金融中介发行的长期名义债务进行融资时，预期通胀的变化会导致跨部门的财富转移。较高的预期通胀会降低企业的实际负债和违约风险，这有助于减轻债务积压。然而，它会损害中介机构的实际资产，导致信贷供给收缩。我们从理论上证明，中介融资条件在名义冲击的传导中发挥关键作用，影响投资者为承担通胀风险所要求的溢价。我们提供了支持我们这一新颖通胀传导机制的经验证据，并将我们的发现与2023年的银行业压力联系起来。我们还表明，同时对金融变量和实际变量作出反应的泰勒规则有助于稳定我们的经济。

source_records.title: Education and the Margins of Cyclical Adjustment in the Labour Market
source_records.abstract: Allocative wages—the labour costs considered when deciding to form or dissolve a long-term employment relationship—are more sensitive to cyclical conditions for more educated workers. Specifically, college-educated workers’ allocative wages are highly pro-cyclical, while high school dropouts’ wages exhibit only moderate cyclicality. Further, as education increases, an increasing share of the sensitivity of allocative wages is driven by the persistent scarring effects of the cyclical position at the time of hiring on the wages associated with higher levels of tenure, amounting to more than a third of the overall sensitivity for the college educated. The greater job stability of the more educated—and therefore the exposure to scarring—contributes to these differences. In addition, more significant scarring at each horizon of tenure amplifies the effect. In service of documenting these facts, I develop new methods for inferring the sensitivity of labour costs to shocks when agents are forward-looking and wages may be intertemporally smoothed.

before.title_zh: 教育与劳动力市场周期性调整的边缘
before.abstract_zh: 配置性工资——即在决定建立或解除长期雇佣关系时所考虑的劳动力成本——对受过更多教育的劳动者而言对周期性条件更为敏感。具体而言，大学学历劳动者的配置性工资具有高度顺周期性，而高中辍学者的工资仅表现出适度的周期性。此外，随着教育程度提高，配置性工资敏感性中越来越大的份额由招聘时周期性位置对与更高任期水平相关工资的持久性创伤效应所驱动，对大学学历者而言，这一份额超过总体敏感性的三分之一。受教育程度更高者更强的就业稳定性——因而对创伤效应的暴露——促成了这些差异。此外，在每个任期水平上更显著的创伤效应放大了这一效应。为记录这些事实，我开发了新的方法，用于在代理人具有前瞻性且工资可能跨期平滑时推断劳动力成本对冲击的敏感性。

decisions.title: The Illiquidity of Water Markets

source_records.title: The Illiquidity of Water Markets
source_records.abstract: We investigate the efficiency of a market relative to a non-market institution—an auction relative to a quota—as allocation mechanisms in the presence of frictions. We use data from water markets in southeastern Spain and explore a specific change in the institutions to allocate water. On the one hand, frictions arose because poor farmers were liquidity constrained. On the other hand, farmers who were part of the wealthy elite were not liquidity constrained. We estimate a structural dynamic demand model by taking advantage of the fact that water demand for both types of farmers is determined by the technological constraint imposed by the crop’s production function. This approach allows us to differentiate liquidity constraints from unobserved heterogeneity. We show that the institutional change from an auction to a quota increased total efficiency for the farmers considered. Welfare increased by 23.4 real pesetas per farmer per tree, a 6 % increase in total production relative to the market.
