decisions.title: Selection in Surveys: Using Randomized Incentives to Detect and Account for Nonresponse Bias

source_records.title: Selection in Surveys: Using Randomized Incentives to Detect and Account for Nonresponse Bias
source_records.abstract: We show how to use randomized participation incentives to test and account for nonresponse bias in surveys. We first use data from a survey about labour market conditions, linked to full-population administrative data, to provide evidence of large differences in labour market outcomes between survey participants and nonparticipants, differences which would not be observable to an analyst who only has access to the survey data. These differences persist even after correcting for observable characteristics. We then use the randomized incentives in our survey to directly test for nonresponse bias and find evidence of substantial bias. Next, we apply a range of existing methods that account for nonresponse bias and find they produce bounds (or point estimates) that are either wide or far from the ground truth. We investigate the failure of these methods by taking a closer look at the determinants of participation, finding that the composition of participants changes in opposite directions in response to incentives and reminder emails. We develop a model of participation that allows for two dimensions of unobserved heterogeneity in the participation decision. Applying the model to our data produces bounds (or point estimates) that are narrower and closer to the ground truth than the other methods. Our results highlight the benefits of including randomized participation incentives in surveys. Both the testing procedure and the methods for bias adjustment may be attractive tools for researchers who are able to embed randomized incentives into their survey.

before.title_zh: 调查中的选择：使用随机激励来检测和解释无应答偏差
before.abstract_zh: 我们展示了如何利用随机参与激励来检验和解释调查中的无应答偏差。我们首先使用一项关于劳动力市场状况的调查数据，并将其与全人口行政数据相关联，以提供证据表明调查参与者和非参与者之间在劳动力市场结果上存在巨大差异，而这些差异是仅能获取调查数据的分析人员所无法观察到的。即使在对可观察特征进行校正后，这些差异依然存在。然后，我们利用调查中的随机激励来直接检验无应答偏差，并发现了显著偏差的证据。接下来，我们应用一系列现有的解释无应答偏差的方法，发现它们产生的界限（或点估计）要么过宽，要么远离真实值。我们通过更仔细地考察参与的决定因素来研究这些方法的失败，发现参与者的构成会因激励和提醒邮件而朝相反方向变化。我们建立了一个参与模型，该模型允许参与决策中存在两个维度的不可观测异质性。将该模型应用于我们的数据，产生的界限（或点估计）比其他方法更窄且更接近真实值。我们的结果凸显了在调查中纳入随机参与激励的好处。对于能够将随机激励嵌入其调查的研究人员来说，检验程序和偏差调整方法都可能是有吸引力的工具。

existing_records.title: Selection in Surveys: Using Randomized Incentives to Detect and Account for Nonresponse Bias
existing_records.abstract: We show how to use randomized participation incentives to test and account for nonresponse bias in surveys. We first use data from a survey about labour market conditions, linked to full-population administrative data, to provide evidence of large differences in labour market outcomes between survey participants and nonparticipants, differences which would not be observable to an analyst who only has access to the survey data. These differences persist even after correcting for observable characteristics. We then use the randomized incentives in our survey to directly test for nonresponse bias and find evidence of substantial bias. Next, we apply a range of existing methods that account for nonresponse bias and find they produce bounds (or point estimates) that are either wide or far from the ground truth. We investigate the failure of these methods by taking a closer look at the determinants of participation, finding that the composition of participants changes in opposite directions in response to incentives and reminder emails. We develop a model of participation that allows for two dimensions of unobserved heterogeneity in the participation decision. Applying the model to our data produces bounds (or point estimates) that are narrower and closer to the ground truth than the other methods. Our results highlight the benefits of including randomized participation incentives in surveys. Both the testing procedure and the methods for bias adjustment may be attractive tools for researchers who are able to embed randomized incentives into their survey.

after.title_zh: 调查中的选择：使用随机激励来检测和解释无应答偏差
after.abstract_zh: 我们展示了如何利用随机参与激励来检验和解释调查中的无应答偏差。我们首先使用一项关于劳动力市场状况的调查数据，并将其与全人口行政数据相关联，以提供证据表明调查参与者和非参与者之间在劳动力市场结果上存在巨大差异，而这些差异是仅能获取调查数据的分析人员所无法观察到的。即使在对可观察特征进行校正后，这些差异依然存在。然后，我们利用调查中的随机激励来直接检验无应答偏差，并发现了显著偏差的证据。接下来，我们应用一系列现有的解释无应答偏差的方法，发现它们产生的界限（或点估计）要么过宽，要么远离真实值。我们通过更仔细地考察参与的决定因素来研究这些方法的失败，发现参与者的构成会因激励和提醒邮件而朝相反方向变化。我们建立了一个参与模型，该模型允许参与决策中存在两个维度的不可观测异质性。将该模型应用于我们的数据，产生的界限（或点估计）比其他方法更窄且更接近真实值。我们的结果凸显了在调查中纳入随机参与激励的好处。对于能够将随机激励嵌入其调查的研究人员来说，检验程序和偏差调整方法都可能是有吸引力的工具。

decisions.title: Devaluations, Deposit Dollarization, and Household Heterogeneity

source_records.title: Devaluations, Deposit Dollarization, and Household Heterogeneity
source_records.abstract: We study the aggregate and redistributive effects of currency devaluations in a small open economy model with leverage-constrained banks and heterogeneous households. Our framework captures three stylized facts about financial dollarization in emerging economies: (1) a sizable share of domestic deposits is denominated in foreign currency; (2) these deposits represent significant foreign currency liabilities for local banks; and (3) dollar deposits are mainly held by wealthier households. A devaluation increases the real burden of foreign currency debt, causing an erosion of banks’ net worth, which depresses credit supply and economic activity. While richer households are partially insulated through their dollar deposits, poorer households cut consumption sharply in response to rising borrowing costs and falling real labor income. In our model deposit, dollarization amplifies the contractionary effects of a devaluation on output, investment, and consumption, in line with new empirical evidence for emerging economies. To achieve this result, both constrained intermediaries and heterogeneous households are crucial. In our framework, regulating dollarization can result in widespread welfare gains, especially for poorer households.

before.title_zh: 贬值、存款美元化与家庭异质性
before.abstract_zh: 我们研究小型开放经济中货币贬值的总量效应与再分配效应，该模型包含受杠杆约束的银行和异质性家庭。我们的框架刻画了新兴经济体金融美元化的三个典型事实：（1）相当大比例的国内存款以外币计价；（2）这些存款构成当地银行重要的外币负债；（3）美元存款主要由较富裕家庭持有。贬值增加了外币债务的实际负担，导致银行净值受损，从而抑制信贷供给和经济活动。较富裕家庭通过其美元存款得到部分缓冲，而较贫穷家庭则因借贷成本上升和实际劳动收入下降而大幅削减消费。在我们的模型中，存款美元化放大了贬值对产出、投资和消费的收缩效应，这与针对新兴经济体的新经验证据一致。要得到这一结果，受约束的中介机构和异质性家庭都至关重要。在我们的框架中，对美元化进行监管可以带来广泛的福利收益，尤其是对较贫穷家庭而言。

source_records.abstract: We derive wage equations with individual-specific coefficients from a structural model of human capital investment over the life-cycle. This model allows for interruptions in labour market participation and deals with missing data and attrition problems. We propose a new framework that deals with missingness at random and is based on factor decompositions that allow for flexible control of selection. Our approach leads to an interactive effect wage specification, which we estimate using long administrative panel data on male wages in the private sector in France. A structural function approach shows that interruptions negatively affect average wages. Interestingly, they also negatively affect the inter-decile range of wages after twenty years. This is only partly due to the fact that interruptions are endogenous.

before.title_zh: 生命周期工资与人力资本投资：选择与缺失数据
before.abstract_zh: 我们从生命周期人力资本投资的结构模型中推导出具有个体特定系数的工资方程。该模型允许劳动力市场参与的中断，并处理缺失数据和样本流失问题。我们提出了一个新框架，该框架处理随机缺失，并基于因子分解，从而允许对选择进行灵活控制。我们的方法引出一个交互效应工资设定，我们使用法国私营部门男性工资的长期行政面板数据对其进行估计。结构函数方法表明，中断对平均工资产生负面影响。有趣的是，二十年后，中断还对工资的十分位间距产生负面影响。这仅部分归因于中断是内生的这一事实。

decisions.title: Bank Information Production Over the Business Cycle

source_records.title: Bank Information Production Over the Business Cycle
source_records.abstract: The information banks produce drives their lending decisions and macroeconomic outcomes, but this information is inherently difficult to analyse because it is private. We construct a novel measure of bank information quality from confidential regulatory data that include banks’ private risk assessments for US corporate loans. Information quality improves as local economic conditions deteriorate, particularly for new loans, large loans, and loans with higher expected losses. Information quality also declines during periods of rapid local house price appreciation. Our results provide empirical support for theories of countercyclical information production in credit markets.

before.title_zh: 经济周期中的银行信息生产
before.abstract_zh: 银行生产的信息驱动其贷款决策和宏观经济结果，但这些信息因其私有性而本质上难以分析。我们利用包含银行对美国公司贷款私人风险评估的保密监管数据，构建了一种新的银行信息质量衡量指标。随着当地经济状况恶化，信息质量会提高，对于新贷款、大额贷款以及预期损失较高的贷款尤其如此。在地方房价快速上涨期间，信息质量也会下降。我们的结果为信贷市场中逆周期信息生产的理论提供了经验支持。

after.title_original: Bank Information Production Over the Business Cycle
after.abstract_original: The information banks produce drives their lending decisions and macroeconomic outcomes, but this information is inherently difficult to analyse because it is private. We construct a novel measure of bank information quality from confidential regulatory data that include banks’ private risk assessments for US corporate loans. Information quality improves as local economic conditions deteriorate, particularly for new loans, large loans, and loans with higher expected losses. Information quality also declines during periods of rapid local house price appreciation. Our results provide empirical support for theories of countercyclical information production in credit markets.
after.title_zh: 经济周期中的银行信息生产
after.abstract_zh: 银行生产的信息驱动其贷款决策和宏观经济结果，但这些信息因其私有性而本质上难以分析。我们利用包含银行对美国公司贷款私人风险评估的保密监管数据，构建了一种新的银行信息质量衡量指标。随着当地经济状况恶化，信息质量会提高，对于新贷款、大额贷款以及预期损失较高的贷款尤其如此。在地方房价快速上涨期间，信息质量也会下降。我们的结果为信贷市场中逆周期信息生产的理论提供了经验支持。

existing_records.title: Bank Information Production Over the Business Cycle
existing_records.abstract: The information banks produce drives their lending decisions and macroeconomic outcomes, but this information is inherently difficult to analyse because it is private. We construct a novel measure of bank information quality from confidential regulatory data that include banks’ private risk assessments for US corporate loans. Information quality improves as local economic conditions deteriorate, particularly for new loans, large loans, and loans with higher expected losses. Information quality also declines during periods of rapid local house price appreciation. Our results provide empirical support for theories of countercyclical information production in credit markets.

source_records.title: The Economics of Equilibrium with Indivisible Goods
source_records.abstract: This paper develops a theory of competitive equilibrium with indivisible goods based entirely on economic conditions on demand. The key idea is to analyze complementarity and substitutability between bundles of goods, rather than merely between goods themselves. This approach allows us to formulate sufficient and essentially necessary conditions for equilibrium existence—which unify settings with complements and settings with substitutes. Our analysis has implications for auction design.

before.title_zh: 不可分商品均衡的经济学
before.abstract_zh: 本文完全基于需求的经济条件，发展了一种不可分商品的竞争均衡理论。其核心思想是分析商品束之间的互补性与替代性，而不仅仅是商品本身之间的互补性与替代性。这一方法使我们能够为均衡存在性构建充分且本质上必要的条件——这些条件统一了存在互补品的设定与存在替代品的设定。我们的分析对拍卖设计具有启示意义。

decisions.title: Latent Heterogeneity in the Marginal Propensity to Consume

source_records.title: Latent Heterogeneity in the Marginal Propensity to Consume
source_records.abstract: We estimate the unconditional distribution of the marginal propensity to consume (MPC) using clustering regression applied to the 2008 economic stimulus payments. By deviating from the standard approach of estimating MPC heterogeneity using interactions with observables, we can recover the full distribution of MPCs. We find households spent between 4 and 133% of the rebate within a quarter, and individual households used rebates for different goods. While many observable characteristics correlate individually with our estimated MPCs, most of these relationships disappear when tested jointly. Notable exceptions are income and the average propensity to consume, which correlate positively with the MPC. Household observable characteristics explain only 8% of MPC variation, highlighting the role of latent heterogeneity.
source_records.raw_title: Latent Heterogeneity in the Marginal Propensity to Consume
source_records.raw_abstract:
Abstract
We estimate the unconditional distribution of the marginal propensity to consume (MPC) using clustering regression applied to the 2008 economic stimulus payments. By deviating from the standard approach of estimating MPC heterogeneity using interactions with observables, we can recover the full distribution of MPCs. We find households spent between 4 and 133% of the rebate within a quarter, and individual households used rebates for different goods. While many observable characteristics correlate individually with our estimated MPCs, most of these relationships disappear when tested jointly. Notable exceptions are income and the average propensity to consume, which correlate positively with the MPC. Household observable characteristics explain only 8% of MPC variation, highlighting the role of latent heterogeneity.

before.title_zh: 边际消费倾向中的潜在异质性
before.abstract_zh: 我们利用聚类回归方法，基于2008年经济刺激付款，估计了边际消费倾向（MPC）的无条件分布。通过偏离使用可观测变量交互项来估计MPC异质性的标准方法，我们能够恢复MPC的完整分布。我们发现家庭在一个季度内花费了退税款的4%至133%，并且各个家庭将退税款用于不同的商品。尽管许多可观测特征分别与我们估计的MPC相关，但在联合检验时，这些关系大多消失。显著的例外是收入和平均消费倾向，它们与MPC正相关。家庭可观测特征仅解释了MPC变异的8%，凸显了潜在异质性的作用。

source_records.title: A Robust Test for Weak Instruments for 2SLS with Multiple Endogenous Regressors
source_records.abstract: We develop a test for instrument strength based on the bias of two-stage least squares (2SLS) that (1) generalizes Stock and Yogo’s and Sanderson and Windmeijer’s tests to be robust to heteroskedasticity and autocorrelation, and (2) extends Montiel Olea and Pflueger’s robust test for models with a single endogenous regressor to multiple endogenous regressors. Our test can be based either on an absolute bias criterion or on the 2SLS bias relative to a worst-case benchmark. We also develop extensions to test whether weak instruments cause bias in individual 2SLS coefficients. In simulations, our test controls size and is powerful, and we provide efficient code packages for its practical implementation. We demonstrate our testing procedures in the context of the estimation of state-dependent fiscal multipliers, following recent leading estimates.

before.title_zh: 针对含多个内生回归元的2SLS的弱工具变量稳健检验

decisions.title: Firm Quality Dynamics and the Slippery Slope of Credit Intervention

source_records.title: Firm Quality Dynamics and the Slippery Slope of Credit Intervention
source_records.abstract: A salient trend in crisis intervention has emerged in recent decades: government and central banks have offered funding directly to nonfinancial firms, bypassing banks and other credit intermediaries. We analyse the long-term consequences of such policies by focussing on firm quality dynamics. In a laissez-faire economy, firms with high productivity are more likely to survive crises than those with low productivity. The government funding support saves more firms but cannot be customized based on firm productivity, dampening the cleansing effect of crises. The policy distortion is self-perpetuating: a downward bias in the firm quality distribution necessitates larger interventions in future crises. Our mechanism is quantitatively important: we show that if policymakers ignore such distortionary effects on firm quality dynamics, the resultant credit intervention would almost double the optimal amount.

before.title_zh: 企业质量动态与信贷干预的滑坡效应
before.abstract_zh: 近几十年来，危机干预中出现了一个显著趋势：政府和中央银行绕过银行及其他信贷中介，直接向非金融企业提供资金。我们通过聚焦企业质量动态来分析此类政策的长期后果。在自由放任的经济中，高生产率企业比低生产率企业更有可能在危机中存活。政府资金支持挽救了更多企业，但无法根据企业生产率进行定制，从而削弱了危机的净化效应。政策扭曲具有自我延续性：企业质量分布的下行偏差使得未来危机中需要更大规模的干预。我们的机制在数量上具有重要意义：我们表明，如果政策制定者忽视这种对企业质量动态的扭曲效应，由此产生的信贷干预规模将几乎是最优数量的两倍。

after.abstract_original: A salient trend in crisis intervention has emerged in recent decades: government and central banks have offered funding directly to nonfinancial firms, bypassing banks and other credit intermediaries. We analyse the long-term consequences of such policies by focussing on firm quality dynamics. In a laissez-faire economy, firms with high productivity are more likely to survive crises than those with low productivity. The government funding support saves more firms but cannot be customized based on firm productivity, dampening the cleansing effect of crises. The policy distortion is self-perpetuating: a downward bias in the firm quality distribution necessitates larger interventions in future crises. Our mechanism is quantitatively important: we show that if policymakers ignore such distortionary effects on firm quality dynamics, the resultant credit intervention would almost double the optimal amount.
after.title_zh: 企业质量动态与信贷干预的滑坡效应
after.abstract_zh: 近几十年来，危机干预中出现了一个显著趋势：政府和中央银行绕过银行及其他信贷中介，直接向非金融企业提供资金。我们通过聚焦企业质量动态来分析此类政策的长期后果。在自由放任的经济中，高生产率企业比低生产率企业更有可能在危机中存活。政府资金支持挽救了更多企业，但无法根据企业生产率进行定制，从而削弱了危机的净化效应。政策扭曲具有自我延续性：企业质量分布的下行偏差使得未来危机中需要更大规模的干预。我们的机制在数量上具有重要意义：我们表明，如果政策制定者忽视这种对企业质量动态的扭曲效应，由此产生的信贷干预规模将几乎是最优数量的两倍。

decisions.title: Choice and Opportunity Costs

source_records.title: Choice and Opportunity Costs
source_records.abstract: We define the (physical) opportunity cost of a choice x as the alternative that would be chosen if x were not available, and the opportunity cost of any unchosen alternative as x itself. The agent has preferences over pairs consisting of alternatives and their opportunity costs. Because costs affect choice and vice-versa, choice results from an intrapersonal equilibrium rather than from simple maximisation. In spite of significant rationality assumptions, the resulting behaviour can be highly non-standard, allowing intransitive choices. Rational utility maximisation is ensured by an additional new consistency condition on preferences. However, we argue that the maximised utility cannot be straightforwardly interpreted as a welfare relevant “revealed preference”. A generalisation of our model accommodates additional departures from standard rationality in the form of menu effects.

existing_records.title: Choice and Opportunity Costs
existing_records.abstract: We define the (physical) opportunity cost of a choice x as the alternative that would be chosen if x were not available, and the opportunity cost of any unchosen alternative as x itself. The agent has preferences over pairs consisting of alternatives and their opportunity costs. Because costs affect choice and vice-versa, choice results from an intrapersonal equilibrium rather than from simple maximisation. In spite of significant rationality assumptions, the resulting behaviour can be highly non-standard, allowing intransitive choices. Rational utility maximisation is ensured by an additional new consistency condition on preferences. However, we argue that the maximised utility cannot be straightforwardly interpreted as a welfare relevant “revealed preference”. A generalisation of our model accommodates additional departures from standard rationality in the form of menu effects.

decisions.title: Bridges

source_records.title: Bridges
source_records.abstract: Bridges are critical but sparse links in land transport networks. I exploit quasi-experimental variation in bridge construction over major rivers in the U.S. to measure the causal effects of land transport infrastructure. Bridges are more often built upstream than downstream of tributary confluences—where smaller rivers join larger rivers—generating local differences in connectivity. Local connectivity advantages have negative effects on per capita income. In contrast, more substantial changes in connectivity arising from the opening of major bridges increase per capita economic activity. A narrative explanation that can reconcile both results is that land transport infrastructure creates productivity advantages that drive economic growth, structural transformation, and urbanization over large spatial scales, but local sorting within the cities that form around early transport routes then reverses this gradient over smaller spatial scales.

before.title_zh: 桥梁
before.abstract_zh: 桥梁是陆路运输网络中关键但稀疏的环节。我利用美国主要河流上桥梁建设的准实验变异，来衡量陆路运输基础设施的因果效应。在支流汇合处——即较小河流汇入较大河流之处——桥梁更常建在上游而非下游，从而在连通性上产生局部差异。局部连通性优势对人均收入具有负面影响。相比之下，由主要桥梁开通所带来的更显著的连通性变化则增加了人均经济活动。一种能够调和这两种结果的叙事性解释是：陆路运输基础设施创造了生产率优势，这种优势在较大空间尺度上推动了经济增长、结构转型和城市化，但围绕早期运输路线形成的城市内部的局部排序，随后在较小空间尺度上逆转了这一梯度。

decisions.title: Costly Multidimensional Screening

source_records.title: Costly Multidimensional Screening
source_records.abstract: A screening instrument is costly if it is socially wasteful and productive otherwise. A principal screens an agent with multidimensional private information and quasilinear preferences that are additively separable across two components: a one-dimensional productive component and a multidimensional costly component. Can the principal improve upon simple one-dimensional mechanisms by also using the costly instruments? We show that if the agent has preferences between the two components that are positively correlated in a suitably defined sense, then simply screening the productive component is optimal. The result holds for general type and allocation spaces, and allows for nonlinear and interdependent valuations. We discuss applications to monopoly pricing, bundling, and labour market screening.
source_records.raw_title: Costly Multidimensional Screening
source_records.raw_abstract:
Abstract
A screening instrument is costly if it is socially wasteful and productive otherwise. A principal screens an agent with multidimensional private information and quasilinear preferences that are additively separable across two components: a one-dimensional productive component and a multidimensional costly component. Can the principal improve upon simple one-dimensional mechanisms by also using the costly instruments? We show that if the agent has preferences between the two components that are positively correlated in a suitably defined sense, then simply screening the productive component is optimal. The result holds for general type and allocation spaces, and allows for nonlinear and interdependent valuations. We discuss applications to monopoly pricing, bundling, and labour market screening.

source_records.title: Machine Learning and the Implementable Efficient Frontier
source_records.abstract: We propose that investment strategies should be evaluated based on their net-of-trading-cost return for each level of risk, which we term the “implementable efficient frontier.” While numerous studies use machine learning return forecasts to generate portfolios, their agnosticism toward trading costs leads to excessive reliance on fleeting small-scale characteristics, resulting in poor net returns. We develop a framework that produces a superior frontier by integrating trading-cost-aware portfolio optimization with machine learning. The superior net-of-cost performance is achieved by learning directly about portfolio weights using an economic objective. Further, our model gives rise to a new measure of “economic feature importance.”

blocks.text: Machine Learning and the Implementable Efficient Frontier
Machine Learning and the Implementable Efficient Frontier
Machine Learning and the Implementable Efficient Frontier

We propose that investment strategies should be evaluated based on their net-of-trading-cost return for each level of risk, which we term the “implementable efficient frontier.” While numerous studies use machine learning return forecasts to generate portfolios, their agnosticism toward trading costs leads to excessive reliance on fleeting small-scale characteristics, resulting in poor net returns. We develop a framework that produces a superior frontier by integrating trading-cost-aware portfolio optimization with machine learning. The superior net-of-cost performance is achieved by learning directly about portfolio weights using an economic objective. Further, our model gives rise to a new measure of “economic feature importance.”

before.abstract_zh: 我们提出，投资策略应根据其在每一风险水平下的扣除交易成本后的收益来评估，我们将其称为“可实施的有效前沿”。尽管大量研究使用机器学习收益预测来构建投资组合，但它们对交易成本的不敏感导致过度依赖转瞬即逝的小规模特征，从而造成净收益不佳。我们开发了一个框架，通过将交易成本感知的投资组合优化与机器学习相结合，产生一条更优的前沿。这种更优的扣除成本后表现是通过使用经济目标直接学习投资组合权重来实现的。此外，我们的模型催生了一种新的“经济特征重要性”度量。

We develop a framework that produces a superior frontier by integrating trading-cost-aware portfolio optimization with machine learning. The superior net-of-cost performance is achieved by learning directly about portfolio weights using an economic objective. Further, our model gives rise to a new measure of “economic feature importance.”

blocks.text: Machine Learning and the Implementable Efficient Frontier
Machine Learning and the Implementable Efficient Frontier
Machine Learning and the Implementable Efficient Frontier

We propose that investment strategies should be evaluated based on their net-of-trading-cost return for each level of risk, which we term the “implementable efficient frontier.” While numerous studies use machine learning return forecasts to generate portfolios, their agnosticism toward trading costs leads to excessive reliance on fleeting small-scale characteristics, resulting in poor net returns. We develop a framework that produces a superior frontier by integrating trading-cost-aware portfolio optimization with machine learning. The superior net-of-cost performance is achieved by learning directly about portfolio weights using an economic objective. Further, our model gives rise to a new measure of “economic feature importance.”

source_records.title: Dynamics of Asset Demands with Confidence Heterogeneity
source_records.abstract: To understand the dynamics of investors’ asset demands, we develop a general-equilibrium model driven by a single latent variable: heterogeneity in investors’ confidence about mean endowment growth. The model predicts persistent heterogeneity in asset demands and concentrated portfolios. Consistent with the data, limited confidence reduces investors’ demand elasticities and makes stock prices excessively volatile—driven by latent demand rather than observable characteristics. The underlying economic mechanisms are driven primarily by investors’ desire to hedge changes in future beliefs instead of current disagreement. Finally, consistent with survey data, investors’ expectations correlate positively with past returns and negatively with future returns.

blocks.text: Dynamics of Asset Demands with Confidence Heterogeneity
Dynamics of Asset Demands with Confidence Heterogeneity
Dynamics of Asset Demands with Confidence Heterogeneity

To understand the dynamics of investors’ asset demands, we develop a general-equilibrium model driven by a single latent variable: heterogeneity in investors’ confidence about mean endowment growth. The model predicts persistent heterogeneity in asset demands and concentrated portfolios. Consistent with the data, limited confidence reduces investors’ demand elasticities and makes stock prices excessively volatile—driven by latent demand rather than observable characteristics. The underlying economic mechanisms are driven primarily by investors’ desire to hedge changes in future beliefs instead of current disagreement. Finally, consistent with survey data, investors’ expectations correlate positively with past returns and negatively with future returns.

before.title_zh: 信心异质性下资产需求的动态变化
before.abstract_zh: 为理解投资者资产需求的动态变化，我们构建了一个由单一潜在变量驱动的广义均衡模型：投资者对平均禀赋增长信心的异质性。该模型预测资产需求存在持续异质性以及组合集中化。与数据一致，有限的信心降低了投资者的需求弹性，并使股票价格过度波动——这由潜在需求而非可观测特征所驱动。其背后的经济机制主要由投资者对冲未来信念变化而非当前分歧的意愿所驱动。最后，与调查数据一致，投资者的预期与过去收益正相关，与未来收益负相关。

after.abstract_original: To understand the dynamics of investors’ asset demands, we develop a general-equilibrium model driven by a single latent variable: heterogeneity in investors’ confidence about mean endowment growth. The model predicts persistent heterogeneity in asset demands and concentrated portfolios. Consistent with the data, limited confidence reduces investors’ demand elasticities and makes stock prices excessively volatile—driven by latent demand rather than observable characteristics. The underlying economic mechanisms are driven primarily by investors’ desire to hedge changes in future beliefs instead of current disagreement. Finally, consistent with survey data, investors’ expectations correlate positively with past returns and negatively with future returns.

after.title_zh: 信心异质性下资产需求的动态变化
after.abstract_zh: 为理解投资者资产需求的动态变化，我们构建了一个由单一潜在变量驱动的广义均衡模型：投资者对平均禀赋增长信心的异质性。该模型预测资产需求存在持续异质性以及组合集中化。与数据一致，有限的信心降低了投资者的需求弹性，并使股票价格过度波动——这由潜在需求而非可观测特征所驱动。其背后的经济机制主要由投资者对冲未来信念变化而非当前分歧的意愿所驱动。最后，与调查数据一致，投资者的预期与过去收益正相关，与未来收益负相关。

source_records.title: Partial Equilibrium Thinking, Extrapolation, and Bubbles
source_records.abstract: We develop a dynamic theory of “Partial Equilibrium Thinking” (PET), which micro-founds time-varying return extrapolation: extrapolative beliefs are present at all times, but only sometimes manifest themselves in explosive ways. We formalize the distinction between normal times shocks and “displacement shocks,” and study their interaction with extrapolative beliefs. In normal times, PET generates constant extrapolation and momentum. After a displacement shock that increases uncertainty, PET leads to stronger and time-varying extrapolation, triggering bubbles and endogenous crashes. Our theory sheds light on both market dynamics in normal times and Kindleberger’s narrative of bubbles within a unified framework.

Partial Equilibrium Thinking, Extrapolation, and Bubbles
Partial Equilibrium Thinking, Extrapolation, and Bubbles

We develop a dynamic theory of “Partial Equilibrium Thinking” (PET), which micro-founds time-varying return extrapolation: extrapolative beliefs are present at all times, but only sometimes manifest themselves in explosive ways. We formalize the distinction between normal times shocks and “displacement shocks,” and study their interaction with extrapolative beliefs. In normal times, PET generates constant extrapolation and momentum. After a displacement shock that increases uncertainty, PET leads to stronger and time-varying extrapolation, triggering bubbles and endogenous crashes. Our theory sheds light on both market dynamics in normal times and Kindleberger’s narrative of bubbles within a unified framework.

before.title_zh: 局部均衡思维、外推与泡沫
before.abstract_zh: 我们发展了一种关于“局部均衡思维”（PET）的动态理论，该理论为时变收益外推提供了微观基础：外推性信念始终存在，但只是有时会以爆发性的方式显现出来。我们形式化了正常时期冲击与“位移冲击”之间的区别，并研究了它们与外推性信念的相互作用。在正常时期，PET产生恒定的外推和动量。在增加不确定性的位移冲击之后，PET导致更强且时变的外推，引发泡沫和内生性崩盘。我们的理论在一个统一框架内阐明了正常时期的市场动态以及Kindleberger关于泡沫的叙述。

existing_records.title: Partial Equilibrium Thinking, Extrapolation, and Bubbles
existing_records.abstract: We develop a dynamic theory of “Partial Equilibrium Thinking” (PET), which micro-founds time-varying return extrapolation: extrapolative beliefs are present at all times, but only sometimes manifest themselves in explosive ways. We formalize the distinction between normal times shocks and “displacement shocks,” and study their interaction with extrapolative beliefs. In normal times, PET generates constant extrapolation and momentum. After a displacement shock that increases uncertainty, PET leads to stronger and time-varying extrapolation, triggering bubbles and endogenous crashes. Our theory sheds light on both market dynamics in normal times and Kindleberger’s narrative of bubbles within a unified framework.

after.title_zh: 局部均衡思维、外推与泡沫
after.abstract_zh: 我们发展了一种关于“局部均衡思维”（PET）的动态理论，该理论为时变收益外推提供了微观基础：外推性信念始终存在，但只是有时会以爆发性的方式显现出来。我们形式化了正常时期冲击与“位移冲击”之间的区别，并研究了它们与外推性信念的相互作用。在正常时期，PET产生恒定的外推和动量。在增加不确定性的位移冲击之后，PET导致更强且时变的外推，引发泡沫和内生性崩盘。我们的理论在一个统一框架内阐明了正常时期的市场动态以及Kindleberger关于泡沫的叙述。

decisions.title: What Hundreds of Economic News Events Say About Belief Overreaction in the Stock Market

source_records.title: What Hundreds of Economic News Events Say About Belief Overreaction in the Stock Market
source_records.abstract: We measure the nature and severity of a variety of belief distortions in market reactions to hundreds of economic news events by synthesizing structural estimation with algorithmic machine learning to quantify bias. We find that investors systematically overreact to perceptions about multiple fundamental shocks, a phenomenon we show often dampens rather than amplifies market volatility via a “shock composition effect.” Such effects imply that the stock market can underreact to news, even when investors overreact to all shocks.

before.title_zh: 数百个经济新闻事件对股市信念过度反应说明了什么
before.abstract_zh: 我们通过将结构估计与算法机器学习相结合来量化偏差，衡量了市场对数百个经济新闻事件反应中多种信念扭曲的性质与严重程度。我们发现，投资者会系统性地对多种基本面冲击的感知过度反应，我们表明这一现象往往通过一种“冲击构成效应”抑制而非放大市场波动。此类效应意味着，即便投资者对所有冲击都过度反应，股市仍可能对新闻反应不足。

decisions.title: Beliefs and Portfolios: Causal Evidence

source_records.title: Beliefs and Portfolios: Causal Evidence
source_records.abstract: We causally test alternative theories of expectation formation. Using a randomized information experiment we show overreaction is a key feature of individuals’ return expectations, and individuals’ response to the price-earnings ratio is opposite of academic consensus. Our evidence is inconsistent with standard models of expectation formation, but subjective mental models that deviate from objective benchmarks can jointly explain the updating behavior in the experiment, the link between individuals’ prior perceptions and expectations, and the heterogeneity of updating. Conditional on their beliefs, individuals’ sensitivity of equity shares in a hypothetical portfolio choice experiment is consistent with the standard Merton model.

blocks.text: Beliefs and Portfolios: Causal Evidence
Beliefs and Portfolios: Causal Evidence
Beliefs and Portfolios: Causal Evidence

We causally test alternative theories of expectation formation. Using a randomized information experiment we show overreaction is a key feature of individuals’ return expectations, and individuals’ response to the price-earnings ratio is opposite of academic consensus. Our evidence is inconsistent with standard models of expectation formation, but subjective mental models that deviate from objective benchmarks can jointly explain the updating behavior in the experiment, the link between individuals’ prior perceptions and expectations, and the heterogeneity of updating. Conditional on their beliefs, individuals’ sensitivity of equity shares in a hypothetical portfolio choice experiment is consistent with the standard Merton model.

source_records.title: What Drives Variation in Investor Portfolios? Estimating the Roles of Beliefs and Risk Preferences
source_records.abstract: We present a portfolio choice demand model that allows for the nonparametric estimation of investors’ (subjective) expectations and risk preferences. Using comprehensive 401(k)-plan-level data from 2009 through 2019, we explore heterogeneity in asset allocations using our empirical framework. We recover investors’ beliefs about each asset and examine the implications and potential sources of those beliefs. Heterogeneity in expectations across investors accounts for twice as much variation in portfolio holdings as heterogeneity in risk aversion. Belief heterogeneity is partly driven by investors’ characteristics and experiences, reflecting local sources of information such as county-level GDP and employers’ past performance.

What Drives Variation in Investor Portfolios? Estimating the Roles of Beliefs and Risk Preferences
What Drives Variation in Investor Portfolios? Estimating the Roles of Beliefs and Risk Preferences

We present a portfolio choice demand model that allows for the nonparametric estimation of investors’ (subjective) expectations and risk preferences. Using comprehensive 401(k)-plan-level data from 2009 through 2019, we explore heterogeneity in asset allocations using our empirical framework. We recover investors’ beliefs about each asset and examine the implications and potential sources of those beliefs. Heterogeneity in expectations across investors accounts for twice as much variation in portfolio holdings as heterogeneity in risk aversion. Belief heterogeneity is partly driven by investors’ characteristics and experiences, reflecting local sources of information such as county-level GDP and employers’ past performance.

before.title_zh: 什么驱动了投资者投资组合的变异？估计信念与风险偏好的作用
before.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个投资组合选择需求模型，该模型允许对投资者的（主观）预期和风险偏好进行非参数估计。利用从2009年到2019年的全面401(k)-计划层面数据，我们使用我们的实证框架探讨了资产配置中的异质性。我们还原了投资者对每种资产的信念，并考察了这些信念的含义和潜在来源。投资者之间预期的异质性对投资组合持有变异的解释力是风险厌恶异质性的两倍。信念异质性部分由投资者的特征和经历驱动，反映了地方信息来源，如县级GDP和雇主的过往表现。

existing_records.title: What Drives Variation in Investor Portfolios? Estimating the Roles of Beliefs and Risk Preferences
existing_records.abstract: We present a portfolio choice demand model that allows for the nonparametric estimation of investors’ (subjective) expectations and risk preferences. Using comprehensive 401(k)-plan-level data from 2009 through 2019, we explore heterogeneity in asset allocations using our empirical framework. We recover investors’ beliefs about each asset and examine the implications and potential sources of those beliefs. Heterogeneity in expectations across investors accounts for twice as much variation in portfolio holdings as heterogeneity in risk aversion. Belief heterogeneity is partly driven by investors’ characteristics and experiences, reflecting local sources of information such as county-level GDP and employers’ past performance.

after.title_zh: 什么驱动了投资者投资组合的变异？估计信念与风险偏好的作用
after.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个投资组合选择需求模型，该模型允许对投资者的（主观）预期和风险偏好进行非参数估计。利用从2009年到2019年的全面401(k)-计划层面数据，我们使用我们的实证框架探讨了资产配置中的异质性。我们还原了投资者对每种资产的信念，并考察了这些信念的含义和潜在来源。投资者之间预期的异质性对投资组合持有变异的解释力是风险厌恶异质性的两倍。信念异质性部分由投资者的特征和经历驱动，反映了地方信息来源，如县级GDP和雇主的过往表现。

decisions.title: Who Clears the Market When Passive Investors Trade?

source_records.title: Who Clears the Market When Passive Investors Trade?
source_records.abstract: We find that firms are the primary sellers who clear the market for index fund buying, providing shares at a nearly one-for-one rate. Most demand-side institutions trade in the same direction as index funds rather than accommodating passive demand. We use two instruments for index fund demand and show that firms causally respond to exogenous passive demand, with prices serving as the coordinating mechanism. Firms satisfy passive demand mostly through nonprimary market issuance, for example, through employee stock-based compensation. Our results suggest that passive investing has systematically supplied capital to firms by enabling equity issuance over the last two decades.

blocks.text: Who Clears the Market When Passive Investors Trade?
Who Clears the Market When Passive Investors Trade?
Who Clears the Market When Passive Investors Trade?

We find that firms are the primary sellers who clear the market for index fund buying, providing shares at a nearly one-for-one rate. Most demand-side institutions trade in the same direction as index funds rather than accommodating passive demand. We use two instruments for index fund demand and show that firms causally respond to exogenous passive demand, with prices serving as the coordinating mechanism. Firms satisfy passive demand mostly through nonprimary market issuance, for example, through employee stock-based compensation. Our results suggest that passive investing has systematically supplied capital to firms by enabling equity issuance over the last two decades.

before.title_zh: 当被动投资者交易时，谁在清算市场？
before.abstract_zh: 我们发现，公司是主要的卖方，它们以几乎一比一的比例提供股票，为指数基金的买入清算市场。大多数需求侧机构与指数基金同向交易，而不是迎合被动需求。我们为指数基金需求使用了两个工具变量，并表明公司对外生的被动需求做出因果反应，价格充当协调机制。公司主要通过非一级市场发行来满足被动需求，例如通过员工股票薪酬。我们的结果表明，在过去二十年中，被动投资通过使股票发行成为可能，系统性地向公司提供了资本。

Our results suggest that passive investing has systematically supplied capital to firms by enabling equity issuance over the last two decades.

after.title_zh: 当被动投资者交易时，谁在清算市场？
after.abstract_zh: 我们发现，公司是主要的卖方，它们以几乎一比一的比例提供股票，为指数基金的买入清算市场。大多数需求侧机构与指数基金同向交易，而不是迎合被动需求。我们为指数基金需求使用了两个工具变量，并表明公司对外生的被动需求做出因果反应，价格充当协调机制。公司主要通过非一级市场发行来满足被动需求，例如通过员工股票薪酬。我们的结果表明，在过去二十年中，被动投资通过使股票发行成为可能，系统性地向公司提供了资本。

source_records.title: What Drives Momentum and Reversal? Evidence from Day and Night Signals
source_records.abstract: We study how intraday and overnight components of past returns predict future stock returns from 1926 to 2019. Portfolios formed on past intraday returns display momentum without long-term reversal, whereas portfolios formed on past overnight returns display no momentum. We link this asymmetric day-night pattern to the fact that most trading occurs intraday, which has remained stable over time. Evidence from international stock markets, intraday intervals, and analyst expectations suggests that investors underreact to private information revealed through trading. This underreaction mechanism is most consistent with Hong and Stein’s (1999) theory of momentum.

What Drives Momentum and Reversal? Evidence from Day and Night Signals

We study how intraday and overnight components of past returns predict future stock returns from 1926 to 2019. Portfolios formed on past intraday returns display momentum without long-term reversal, whereas portfolios formed on past overnight returns display no momentum. We link this asymmetric day-night pattern to the fact that most trading occurs intraday, which has remained stable over time. Evidence from international stock markets, intraday intervals, and analyst expectations suggests that investors underreact to private information revealed through trading. This underreaction mechanism is most consistent with Hong and Stein’s (1999) theory of momentum.

source_records.title: The Need for Fees at a DEX: How Increases in Fees Can Increase DEX Trading Volume
source_records.abstract: We model endogenous trading and liquidity provision at a decentralized exchange (DEX) and demonstrate that increasing DEX trading fees can increase DEX trading volume. DEXs employ a mechanical pricing rule whereby price impacts decrease with inventory that DEXs acquire by offering fee revenues to investors. Consequently, higher DEX fees can incentivize higher inventory, thereby reducing price impacts. Moreover, the reduction of price impact can offset the increase in fees so that the marginal cost of DEX trading declines despite charging a higher trading fee. In turn, lower DEX marginal trading costs lead to an increase in DEX trading volume.

before.title_zh: DEX对费用的需求：费用增加如何能提高DEX交易量
before.abstract_zh: 我们对去中心化交易所（DEX）中的内生交易与流动性提供进行建模，并证明提高DEX交易费用可以增加DEX交易量。DEX采用一种机械定价规则，即价格影响随DEX通过向投资者提供费用收入而获得的库存增加而减小。因此，更高的DEX费用可以激励更高的库存，从而降低价格影响。此外，价格影响的降低可以抵消费用的增加，以至于尽管收取更高的交易费用，DEX交易的边际成本仍下降。进而，更低的DEX边际交易成本导致DEX交易量增加。

after.title_zh: DEX对费用的需求：费用增加如何能提高DEX交易量
after.abstract_zh: 我们对去中心化交易所（DEX）中的内生交易与流动性提供进行建模，并证明提高DEX交易费用可以增加DEX交易量。DEX采用一种机械定价规则，即价格影响随DEX通过向投资者提供费用收入而获得的库存增加而减小。因此，更高的DEX费用可以激励更高的库存，从而降低价格影响。此外，价格影响的降低可以抵消费用的增加，以至于尽管收取更高的交易费用，DEX交易的边际成本仍下降。进而，更低的DEX边际交易成本导致DEX交易量增加。

source_records.title: Do Mutual Funds Respond to Mechanical Changes in ESG Ratings?
source_records.abstract: Using a quasi-experimental setting, we study whether mutual fund investors respond to a purely mechanical change in environmental, social, and governance (ESG) ratings—that is, a change independent of concurrent changes in firms’ actual ESG activities. We find that when a firm experiences a mechanical increase in ESG ratings, the probability of being selected by an ESG fund increases (extensive margin). In contrast, if the firm is already in the fund’s portfolio, its holdings do not change (intensive margin), consistent with portfolio weighting being based on market capitalization. The selection effect is observable not only among funds that follow an ESG index but also among active ESG funds, which presumably should have the resources and ability to identify and filter out the mechanical increase in ESG ratings. Among active ESG funds, the selection effect is stronger for funds with less assets under management, larger portfolios of firms, and lower expense ratios, consistent with the notion that resource constraints may impede a fund’s screening ability. Our findings imply that passive investing based on commercial ESG ratings—whether due to resource constraints or portfolio indexing—might result in portfolio allocations that do not reflect the actual ESG activities of firms.

before.title_zh: 共同基金会对ESG评级的机械性变化作出反应吗？
before.abstract_zh: 我们利用一个准实验情境，研究共同基金投资者是否会对环境、社会和治理（ESG）评级的纯粹机械性变化作出反应——即一种独立于企业实际ESG活动同期变化的评级变化。我们发现，当一家企业经历ESG评级的机械性上升时，其被ESG基金选中的概率上升（广延边际）。相反，如果该企业已在基金的投资组合中，其持仓不会变化（集约边际），这与投资组合权重基于市值相一致。这种选择效应不仅存在于跟踪ESG指数的基金中，也存在于主动型ESG基金中，而后者按理说应拥有资源和能力来识别并过滤掉ESG评级的机械性上升。在主动型ESG基金中，对于管理资产规模较小、企业投资组合较大以及费用比率较低的基金，选择效应更强，这与资源约束可能阻碍基金筛选能力的观点相一致。我们的发现意味着，基于商业ESG评级的被动投资——无论是由于资源约束还是投资组合指数化——都可能导致投资组合配置并不反映企业实际的ESG活动。
